This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game.

You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly.

We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread.

What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it. incident.io is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge.

AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook.

The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there.

Who you are

  • You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up.

  • Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you.

  • You're genuinely curious about what it's like to be an on-call engineer. Not just the technical side - the stress, the 2am pages, the pressure of being the person whose job it is to fix things fast. That empathy shows up in how you sell.

  • You can hold a technical conversation without leaning on your SE every time. You'll have support when you need it, but you're comfortable going deep on your own.

  • You're scrappy in the best sense - you don't wait for resources, you figure it out. A bigger company with more tools, more inbound, and more hand-holding would actually frustrate you.

  • You pick up the phone. Cold calling doesn't make you wince, and a voicemail doesn't derail your afternoon.

  • Startup life genuinely appeals to you - not as a stepping stone, but because you want to be somewhere your work is visible and your impact is real.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover, we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

title: Lead Legal Counsel, IP
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Bumble Inc.
description_html:
Introduction to Role & Team

At Bumble, our mission is to create a world where healthy and equitable relationships and friendships thrive, and our Legal team plays an important role in protecting the ideas, brands, technology, and experiences that bring that mission to life. As Lead Legal Counsel within our IP team, you’ll be a senior subject-matter expert helping Bumble navigate complex intellectual property questions across our brands, products, technology, content, and creative work. You’ll independently lead significant IP matters and shape practical strategies in close partnership with colleagues across Legal, Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, combining Courage and Curiosity with strong commercial judgement. You’ll also help us explore the opportunities and risks created by AI and other emerging technologies, using AI thoughtfully in your own work while applying human judgement, care, and accountability to the outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape and execute Bumble’s global intellectual property strategy in partnership with Legal leadership, translating business, brand, product, and technology priorities into practical approaches to protection, portfolio management, licensing, and enforcement.

  • Take ownership of significant matters across Bumble’s international trademark, copyright, patent, domain name, trade secret, and broader digital asset portfolio, working with external counsel and specialist providers to protect strategically important intellectual property.

  • Collaborate with purpose across Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, providing practical rights-clearance and IP advice from early concept and development through launch, including trademarks, copyright, publicity rights, creator and talent rights, user-generated content, and third-party materials.

  • Independently lead complex IP enforcement and dispute matters, including infringement, oppositions, litigation support, and evidence management, applying commercial judgement to determine where action can deliver meaningful protection for Bumble’s brands and innovation.

  • Advise on the creation, ownership, protection, licensing, and commercialisation of Bumble-developed intellectual property, and draft and negotiate sophisticated IP arrangements including licences, coexistence agreements, assignments, merchandising arrangements, technology agreements, and strategic partnerships.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on patent strategy, software development, open-source software, and innovation protection, while advising on emerging IP questions involving generative AI, training data, provenance, ownership, licensing, and infringement risk.

  • Take ownership of IP priorities from insight to impact by supporting due diligence for significant partnerships, investments, and acquisitions and by developing practical playbooks, precedents, training, and self-service guidance that help teams identify and manage IP risk consistently.

  • Champion Bumble’s values of Excellence and Respect by providing clear, pragmatic advice to senior stakeholders and maintaining an agile mindset as legal, technology, and business priorities evolve. Use approved AI tools where appropriate to strengthen legal research, review, summarisation, and knowledge management, while carefully assessing outputs for accuracy, privacy, bias, and responsible use.

 

About You

  • You are qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales, or hold an equivalent qualification in another European jurisdiction.

  • Typically requires 8+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • You bring deep intellectual property expertise, particularly across trademarks, copyright, brand protection, licensing, portfolio management, rights clearance, and technology-related IP matters, developed in-house, in private practice, or through a combination of both.

  • You have strong experience advising consumer technology or similarly complex businesses on intellectual property issues involving software, digital content, product innovation, AI, and emerging technologies, and can independently develop practical solutions to significant or unusual legal questions.

  • You are an accomplished drafter and negotiator who can manage sophisticated IP and technology arrangements and translate complex legal concepts into clear recommendations that enable informed commercial decisions.

  • You collaborate with purpose and build trusted relationships with senior partners across different disciplines. You take ownership of challenging matters, see work through from insight to impact, and adapt your approach with an agile mindset as priorities and information evolve.

  • You combine sound commercial judgement with strong organisational and project-management skills, distinguishing material business risks from theoretical ones while effectively managing multiple priorities, international portfolios, external advisers, and specialist providers.

  • You demonstrate Curiosity, Courage, and Excellence in how you work, and you are comfortable identifying and using AI opportunities to improve effectiveness and insight while exercising appropriate human judgement and applying AI responsibly, inclusively, and with care for confidentiality and data privacy.

 

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Flow Engineering
description_html:
About Flow

Flow Engineering is an AI-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor.

About the role

Flow is seeking software engineers to build AI-powered capabilities that help teams author, review, and manage requirements more effectively. You will work on agentic systems engineer and agentic domain engineer workflows—bringing AI into the center of how teams reason about their systems.​

This role sits at the intersection of AI, product, and full-stack engineering: you will take ideas from prototype all the way to stable, observable features in production.​

What you’ll do

  • Design and ship AI-powered features such as assisted requirement drafting, consistency checks, impact analysis, and intelligent suggestions for systems and domain engineers.

  • Build agentic workflows that help “agentic systems engineers” and “agentic domain engineers” explore designs, simulate changes, and validate requirements.​

  • Evaluate and integrate language models and related tooling, optimizing for reliability, latency, cost, and debuggability in production.

  • Build and maintain the surrounding infrastructure: data pipelines, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model management, observability, and safety/guardrails.

  • Work across the stack—from backend integrations and APIs to simple UI hooks—to deliver complete AI features, not just model endpoints.

  • Partner with product and customers to identify high-value workflows, run experiments, and iterate quickly based on usage.

About you

  • 5+ years developing production software, including designing, testing, and operating services at scale in a cloud environment.

  • Hands-on experience with modern LLM providers and tooling (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, vector stores, RAG patterns).

  • Familiarity with prompt design, retrieval-augmented systems, evaluation methods, and safety/guardrail approaches.

  • Ability to reason about tradeoffs between different models, architectures, and deployment patterns and make pragmatic decisions.

  • Comfortable working in a high-ownership, fast-paced environment where experiments and iteration are the norm.

Our stack (AI-leaning)

  • TypeScript/Node.js and Python for AI and backend services.

  • Modern LLM APIs and orchestration libraries for building agentic workflows.

  • Postgres and other managed cloud services for data and state.

How we work & values

  • Speed over everything: prototype AI workflows quickly, then harden what works.​

  • Own, downscope, ship, iterate: one clear owner per feature, from prototype to production.​

  • Fundamentals done well: evaluation, observability, and safety are part of the first version, not an afterthought.​

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Flexible time off and support for experimentation, learning, and staying current with the AI ecosystem.

title: Workplace Experience Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Orbital
description_html:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

The Job, in a Nutshell

Orbital's London office isn't just a place to sit - it's where culture comes to life, where collaboration gets real, and where the best version of our company shows up every day. We need someone to own that.

As Workplace Experience Manager, you'll be the person who makes in-person time feel intentional, energising, and genuinely worth showing up for. You'll spot what needs improving before anyone else does, elevate what's already good into something exceptional, and care deeply about the details that most people never notice - but everyone feels.

This isn't a head-down admin role, and it's not a purely strategic one either. We want someone who can define what "great" looks like and then go make it happen - someone equally at home rethinking the summer party concept and making sure the snacks never run out.

You'll report into our Head of Operations and be based in our London office five days a week.

What You'll Do

Elevate the Workplace Experience

Our office should feel like the best version of Orbital - energising, considered, and somewhere people genuinely want to be. You'll own that. Not by waiting for someone to point out a problem, but by constantly asking what would make this better - and then making it happen.

You will:

  • Assess what’s working and what isn’t, and proactively improve it

  • Refine layout, flow, rituals, and small details that shift perception

  • Raise standards without being asked

You’ll play a central role in shaping our new London office and ensuring the space supports how we work.

Deliver events and rituals that matter

From Wednesday lunches to the summer party, from All Hands to company off-sites - every in-person moment is a chance to reinforce culture, build real connection, and make people feel good about where they work. You'll own the events calendar end-to-end and make sure every event is considered, well-executed, and genuinely worth people's time.

You will:

  • Develop clear concepts and briefs

  • Manage vendors and budgets confidently

  • Create simple communication plans to drive attendance and engagement

  • Design lightweight feedback loops, analyse results, and continuously improve

Run a flawless operation

Great workplace experience starts with a workplace that just works. Snacks stocked. Meeting rooms set up. Vendors sorted. You'll build the systems and habits that keep the fundamentals running so smoothly that nobody has to think about them - because you already have.

You will own:

  • The overall standards and day-to-day functioning of the office environment

  • Vendor relationships, facilities coordination, and office supplies

  • Organising weekly lunches and keeping snacks stocked

  • Health & safety essentials

  • AV and meeting room setup (calls work, screens connect, rooms are ready)

  • Desk booking software: managing the platform and ensuring it reflects real attendance patterns

  • Meeting room scheduling and utilisation: preventing friction and resolving booking issues

You’ll proactively monitor how the office operates, spotting and resolving issues before they surface.

Own the first impression

Whether it's a candidate walking in for their first interview or a new joiner arriving on day one, you're often the first face of Orbital people meet in person. That moment matters more than most people realise. You'll make sure it's warm, considered, and sets exactly the right tone.

Working closely with the People and Talent teams, you will:

  • Ensure interview days run smoothly, including preparing rooms and coordinating logistics

  • Be the welcoming face for candidates on interview days, stepping in as the on-site host when the Talent team aren't available

  • Send welcome emails to new joiners ahead of their start date and add them to the new starter programme calendar

  • Arrange travel for new joiners who are onboarding at another Orbital office

  • Meet new joiners on their first day and lead the office induction alongside IT

  • Act as the primary office point of contact throughout the onboarding period

  • Reinforce and strengthen our employer brand through every in-person interaction with candidates and new joiners

A brilliant office initiative that nobody knows about isn't brilliant. You'll make sure people are informed, excited, and showing up - by communicating clearly, consistently, and with real personality.

You will:

As part of the wider Back Office ecosystem, you’ll support operational processes where workplace and wider operations intersect.

  • Standardising the global office experience: Working alongside our US Office Lead to ensure that everyone at Orbital has a great office experience, regardless of where they are based.

  • High standards, discretion and strong attention to detail

  • Strong operational reliability: you create systems so basics don’t break

  • Proactive ownership: you don’t wait for detailed briefs

  • Background in hospitality or events

Why this might not be for you

  • You see operational work as beneath you. This role involves ordering supplies, sorting the kitchen, and dealing with day-to-day logistics. If you're after a purely strategic position, this isn't it.

  • You prefer steady rhythms or high predictability. There will be weeks where an event or a project requires extra effort. We don't expect it constantly, but flexibility matters.

  • You're not comfortable being in the office most days. This is an in-office role.

  • Large, established companies are more your speed. We're a growing Series B company. Things change, processes are still being built, and comfort with ambiguity is essential.

  • Details don't excite you. The gap between a good workplace and a great one lives in the small things. If you're not someone who cares whether each meeting has a room that works for their agenda or an event feels thoughtful, this won't bring out your best work.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

title: Special Projects
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Seamflow
description_html:
Special Projects

London (Shoreditch) | In person | Full time

About Seamflow

We're removing one of the last great barriers to progress in the physical world. While software moves fast, industries like healthcare, aerospace, and energy are still slowed by outdated, manual systems.

Our vision is to unlock enormous value for Testing, Inspection, and Certification companies globally. The market is vast, the problem is real, and we're just getting started.

We're rapidly growing following our 14x oversubscribed seed round backed by Tier 1 investors including Northzone and Initialized Capital. These funds backed the founders of Coinbase, Reddit, Klarna, and Spotify.

We're growing very fast; demand is outstripping our supply, and we're building fast to keep up.

The Team

Our team includes AI researchers from world-leading academic institutions like Johns Hopkins, MIPT, Oxford, Cambridge and UCL, former founding engineers at unicorn startups, and alumni of X, Google, Amazon, and Yandex, alongside former leaders from McKinsey, BCG and Bain. We look for people who move fast, think clearly, and hold themselves to a high bar. The standard here is very high, and we're looking for someone who raises it further.

The Role

Special Projects sits directly alongside the CEO and Chief of Staff and takes on whatever the company needs most at that moment. There is no fixed remit and there is no playbook.

One month that means preparing the material and the numbers behind a fundraise. The next it's working through legal, regulatory, and market access questions in a country we're entering, or holding an entire function open on your own until we've hired someone permanent into it. Whatever is broken, missing, or unowned lands here first.

Be clear eyed about what this is. It is demanding, and a lot of it is unglamorous. Some of it is detail work that simply has to be right, with nobody available to check it behind you. What we need is a workhorse who is obsessive about detail, who closes things out rather than hands them back, and whose work nobody ever has to second guess. If that reads as a description of you rather than a warning, this is the highest leverage seat in the company for someone early in their career. You will be in the room for decisions most people see five years later.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years in an environment with a high bar and short feedback loops: investment banking, strategy consulting, a fast growing startup, or something equally demanding we haven't thought of.

An exceptional track record: We care that you were at the top of whatever room you were in, academically and professionally.

AI-native: You already run your work through AI and operate at 10x as a result. You reach for these tools by default, not as a novelty, and you're constantly finding new ways to compress what used to take days into hours.

Structured thinking: You break messy, ambiguous problems into parts, work out what actually matters, and sequence it. You can explain your reasoning on a whiteboard in two minutes.

Ruthless organisation: Multiple workstreams, nothing dropped, nothing chased twice, everything written down.

Strong with Excel, slides, and written communication: Most of our work travels as documents and models read by executives at large regulated businesses.

Bias to action: You'd rather ship a good plan today than a perfect one next week.

Work nobody has to check: You close the loop, catch your own mistakes, and flag the things you couldn't resolve rather than leaving them to be discovered.

Low ego, high agency: The work ranges from a board memo to cleaning a customer data set at 9pm. Neither is beneath you, and you'll take on the boring half as readily as the interesting half.

Someone who wants to be in the room, not on a call. This role is in-person, full time at our Shoreditch office.

Nice to have: European languages, particularly German or French.

What You'll Get

A huge amount of responsibility and trust from day one, and direct exposure to every decision that shapes the company

A front row seat to enterprise sales, product, fundraising, and operations, and a real say in all of them

A clear path into an operating or commercial leadership role as we scale or insight into how to start your own tech company some day

A team that moves fast, works hard, and backs each other fully

Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access

description_html:
Staatsfern und unabhängig beaufsichtigt die Bayerische Landeszentrale für neue Medien (BLM) private Rundfunk- und Internetangebote in Bayern. Als moderner Regulierer begleiten wir sowohl die Anbieter als auch die Nutzerinnen und Nutzer kompetent in die Medienzukunft. Wir regulieren, wir fördern, wir forschen und wir informieren. Dafür setzen wir uns ein: Vielfalt, Qualität, Glaubwürdigkeit und Transparenz für eine vielfältige und meinungsfreie Medienlandschaft.

Wir suchen ab sofort in Vollzeit eine Gruppenleitung Kommunikation & Öffentlichkeitsarbeit (m/w/d).

Aufgaben

Als Leitung Kommunikation & Öffentlichkeitsarbeit verantworten Sie die strategische Ausrichtung und operative Steuerung der internen sowie externen Kommunikation und berichten unmittelbar an die Geschäftsleitung.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Strategische Entwicklung, Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und Positionierung der Landeszentrale
  • Beratung der Geschäftsleitung und Fachbereiche in allen kommunikationsbezogenen Fragestellungen sowie Entwicklung von Kommunikationslinien für zentrale Themen
  • Steuerung der Presse- und Medienarbeit auf allen Kommunikationskanälen sowie Sicherstellung eines konsistenten öffentlichen Auftritts einschließlich der Verantwortung für Corporate Design und Identity
  • Mit Ihrem Team sorgen Sie für eine konsistente, verständliche und zeitgemäße Ansprache unserer Zielgruppen
  • Event- und Veranstaltungsorganisation
  • Weiterentwicklung der internen Kommunikation
  • Krisenkommunikation
  • Konzeption und Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Kommunikationsprojekte
  • Transformation und Entwicklung des Teams

Qualifikation

Sie sind eine erfahrene Kommunikationspersönlichkeit mit strategischem Blick, sicherem Sprachgefühl und Verständnis für medienpolitische Themen. Komplexe Inhalte können Sie klar einordnen, verständlich vermitteln und auch in dynamischen Situationen souverän kommunizieren.

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Kommunikation, Medien, Journalismus, Public Relations, Politikwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in strategischer Kommunikation und Pressearbeit sowie in der Beratung von Führungsebenen
  • Verständnis für medienpolitische, gesellschaftliche und verwaltungsbezogene Zusammenhänge
  • Erfahrung in visueller Kommunikation, Corporate Design sowie der Gestaltung von Print- und Digitalmedien; Grafikkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Führungskompetenz und -erfahrung, ausgeprägter Gestaltungswille, hohe Verlässlichkeit und Teamgeist

Benefits

Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz, Gestaltungsspielraum und attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen:

  • 29 Urlaubstage plus zusätzliche freie Tage
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und gute Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf
  • Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Altersversorgung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen
  • Zuschuss zu EGYM Wellpass oder DeutschlandticketJob
  • Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Bürostandort in München mit guter ÖPNV-Anbindung, kostenlosen Parkmöglichkeiten und bezuschusstem Betriebsrestaurant

description_html:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

Wir suchen einen (Junior) SEO & AI Marketing Manager, der*die mit analytischem Scharfsinn und technologischer Neugier unsere Sichtbarkeit aufs nächste Level hebt. Du verstehst modernes SEO nicht als statische Optimierung, sondern als dynamisches Ökosystem, das du durch automatisierte Workflows und KI aktiv skalierst. In dieser Rolle bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie, Technik und Content. Du stellst die Website-Hygiene sicher und steuerst unsere internationalen Teams mit präzisen Briefings.

Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • GEO & AEO (Modern Search): Optimierung unseres Contents für Generative Engine Optimization und Answer Engine Optimization, um in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen (ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) maximale Präsenz zu erzielen.
  • Automation & KI-Workflows: Eigenständige Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung von automatisierten SEO-Prozessen (z.B. automatisierte Briefing-Erstellung) unter Einsatz moderner KI-Tools.
  • Website-Hygiene & Monitoring: Aufsetzen und Überprüfen automatisierter Sanity-Checks und technischer Crawls (z.B. mit Screaming Frog) sowie das direkte Ableiten operativer Maßnahmen.
  • Keywordrecherche & Content-Implementierung: Durchführung von Keyword- und Wettbewerbsrecherchen sowie Qualitätssicherung (UX, Struktur, Scannbarkeit für KI) bei der Implementierung auf der Website.
  • Internationale Steuerung: Standortübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Teams, um strategische Vorgaben in operative Briefings zu übersetzen und lokale Markt-Insights effizient zu nutzen.

Dein Profil

  • Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 2-5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich SEO (Agentur oder Inhouse).
  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Medienwissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Marketing) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Tech-Stack & AI-Affinität: Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen SEO-Tools (Search Console, Ahrefs, SISTRIX, Screaming Frog) sowie erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierungen mittels LLMs, n8n, Make oder Zapier.
  • Analytisches Denken & UX-Auge: Du liebst Daten, erkennst komplexe Zusammenhänge selbstständig, wandelst sie in Action-Items um und bringst ein starkes Gespür für User Intent und Content-Layouts mit.
  • Modern Search Mindset: Du verfolgst die Entwicklung von LLMs und AI Search.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst Projekte proaktiv an, arbeitest lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Tasks den Überblick. Strategischem Wandel (AI Movement) gegenüber bist du besonders resilient.
  • Kommunikation & Sprache: Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch. Du hast keine Scheu vor internationalen Stakeholdern und kannst komplexe SEO-Themen für Laien verständlich herunterbrechen. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unserem brandneuen Büro in Berlin zu arbeiten und hybrid
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

description_html:
Für ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich Healthcare- und Krankenhausbau suchen wir einen Ingenieur Medizintechnik / Healthcare Planning (w/m/d), der seine berufliche Zukunft in der Medizintechnik- und Krankenhausplanung aufbauen möchte.

Die Position eignet sich besonders für Berufseinsteiger sowie Ingenieure mit ersten Berufserfahrungen (ca. 1–3 Jahre). Sie arbeiten an modernen medizinischen Einrichtungen und entwickeln sich in einem erfahrenen Team Schritt für Schritt in die Planung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Healthcare- und Krankenhausprojekte hinein.

Dabei bewegen Sie sich an der spannenden Schnittstelle zwischen Medizintechnik, Architektur und klinischen Anforderungen und arbeiten mit unterschiedlichen Fachdisziplinen und Projektbeteiligten zusammen.

Die Einarbeitung findet direkt am Standort Bozen statt. Zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt lernen Sie auch den deutschen Standort in Bayern und die dortigen Kollegen kennen. Nach abgeschlossener Einarbeitung besteht – sofern gewünscht – grundsätzlich auch die Möglichkeit, vom Standort in Bayern heraus zu arbeiten.

Aufgaben

  • Sie wirken an internationalen Medizintechnikprojekten mit
  • Sie koordinieren technische Fragestellungen und Anforderungen mit Herstellern und Lieferanten medizintechnischer Systeme

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium der Medizintechnik, Biomedical Engineering, Medizinischen Ingenieurwissenschaften, Technischen Medizin oder eine vergleichbare technisch-naturwissenschaftliche Qualifikation
  • Sie besitzen sehr gute Kenntnisse in AutoCAD und/oder Revit
  • Sie bringen ein gutes technisches Verständnis sowie Kenntnisse medizintechnischer Geräte und Systeme mit und können technische Anforderungen sicher in planerische Lösungen übertragen
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, präzise und eigenverantwortlich und finden sich schnell in komplexe technische und klinische Zusammenhänge ein
  • Die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams liegt Ihnen; dabei kommunizieren Sie klar und verbindlich mit Ärzten, Pflegepersonal, Architekten, Ingenieuren und weiteren Projektbeteiligten
  • Sie kommunizieren sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch; weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse, insbesondere Italienisch und Französisch, sind willkommen
  • Sie bringen die für internationale Projekte erforderliche Reisebereitschaft mit

Benefits

  • Intensive fachliche Einarbeitung direkt am Standort Bozen und Begleitung durch ein erfahrenes Team

  • Attraktiver Arbeitsplatz in Bozen im Herzen Südtirols – mit hoher Lebensqualität, alpiner Umgebung und italienischem Lebensgefühl

  • Nach abgeschlossener Einarbeitung besteht auf Wunsch grundsätzlich auch die Möglichkeit, vom Standort in Bayern heraus zu arbeiten

  • Mitarbeit an anspruchsvollen und innovativen Krankenhaus- und Medizintechnikprojekten im internationalen Umfeld

  • Vielseitiges Tätigkeitsfeld an der Schnittstelle von Medizin, Medizintechnik, Architektur, technischer Gebäudeplanung und Digitalisierung

  • Direkte Einblicke in klinische Prozesse und Abläufe sowie deren Umsetzung in der modernen Krankenhausplanung

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und nach Absprache bis zu ein Tag Mobile Office pro Woche

  • Sehr gute Möglichkeit, sich als Berufseinsteiger oder Young Professional systematisch in die Medizintechnik einzuarbeiten und langfristig weiterzuentwickeln

  • Viel Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und fachliche Entwicklung

  • Sie möchten Ihre Erfahrung in der Medizintechnik in internationale Krankenhausprojekte einbringen und können sich Bozen als zukünftigen Arbeits- und Lebensmittelpunkt vorstellen? Dann freue ich mich darauf, Sie kennenzulernen

  • Bewerben Sie sich unkompliziert mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Für einen ersten vertraulichen Austausch stehe ich Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung

title: Senior Grab Crane Operative, Smugglers Way MRF
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Cory Group
description_html:
Step into a vital position at our Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) in Smugglers Way, Wandsworth. This is a fast‑paced, hands‑on operational role at the heart of London’s recycling system. Every day, you’ll be helping turn thousands of tonnes of commingled recyclables into high‑quality materials ready for reprocessing — ensuring that the city’s waste is handled safely, efficiently, and sustainably. 

As a Senior Grab Crane Operative, you’ll take ownership of managing and maintaining bunker levels, coordinating material arriving by dustcart for processing in the MRF. You’ll be the go‑to person for overseeing junior and agency operatives, giving direction, offering guidance, and ensuring everyone works to the highest safety and operational standards. 

You’ll also play a key role in liaising with TAC Control, Shift Supervisors and sampling teams to keep material quality high and operations flowing smoothly. Effective communication and calm decision‑making will be essential, especially in a busy environment where no two days look the same. 

This role also brings opportunities to contribute to wider operational planning — from resource allocation and maintenance coordination to supporting the smooth running of the site. You’ll be central to maintaining a safe, organised and high‑performing facility that helps keep London’s recycling moving.

Please note: This role is Monday to Friday, 14:00 to 22:00.


We’re looking for someone with experience in a similar environment — preferably within recycling, MRF operations or an engineering‑based setting. You should be comfortable making decisions in a high‑pressure operational setting, with a strong understanding of safe working practices and statutory requirements. 

Being a team player is essential. You’ll be guiding junior operatives, supporting colleagues across the facility, and ensuring that daily check sheets, paperwork and handovers are completed clearly and on time. Strong communication skills will help you keep everything running smoothly. 

You’ll need the willingness to work flexibly, including additional hours or alternative shifts as required. A practical mindset, hands‑on attitude and readiness to assist with wider site tasks — including cleaning and maintenance duties — will make you a great fit. 

If you’re driven, reliable and motivated by making a difference in essential environmental operations, you’ll thrive in this role and become a valued part of an experienced and dedicated team.

title: Senior Animator
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Framestore
description_html:
The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

About the role

This is an existing role within our team. As a Senior Animator, you'll be a key creative force in breathing life, weight, and personality into complex three-dimensional characters and photorealistic creatures. You’ll jump straight into the heart of our storytelling, crafting everything from nuanced, emotional facial expressions to epic, high-action combat performances. If you have a passion for mastering complex anatomy and love the challenge of making mythical beasts—whether they walk, fly, or breathe fire—feel completely grounded in reality, this is the place to do it.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate closely with your Animation Lead and Supervisor to produce premium, story-driven animation that elevates the pacing and style of the film.

  • Partner with our Rigging and Pipeline teams, sharing direct feedback to refine character setups, enhance visual quality, and build smoother tool workflows.

  • Animate both primary and secondary characters, ensuring every element in the frame possesses authentic motion and soul.

  • Take ownership of your workflow, keeping production schedules transparent and hitting your deadlines consistently.

  • Mentor and support less senior artists, sharing your craft and helping them grow their skills.

  • Actively tackle creative changes and follow through constructively on supervisor notes and technical feedback.


  • Significant experience animating on large-scale, photorealistic VFX projects, with a showreel that highlights exceptional creature and character performances.

  • Deep production knowledge of Maya.

  • A natural grasp of physical motion, weight, balance, and spatial awareness.

  • A strong foundation in human and animal anatomy, which underpins how you animate complex fantasy muscle structures and locomotion.

  • An understanding of character rigs, animation pipelines, and data transfer between production tools.

  • Clear, constructive communication and a genuinely collaborative approach to working across distributed pipeline teams.

  • Adaptability, an open mind for direction, and a calm, reliable focus when deadlines approach.

You might also have

  • Experience working with, clean-up, or editing of motion capture data.

  • A traditional background in sketching, life drawing, or classic 2D animation.

  • A working knowledge of Modelling or basic scripting (Python/MEL) to streamline workflows.

Accessibility Statement

Our London studio is fully accessible, with step-free entry, accessible toilets on all floors, and quiet spaces available. We are committed to supporting disabled colleagues and providing an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Application Process & Deadline

To apply, please complete the linked application form or email your resume and portfolio to

The application deadline is **21st June 2026**.

We review all applications manually and do not use artificial intelligence to screen candidates. If you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please let us know—we are happy to accommodate your needs.

title: Senior Cloud Developer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Framestore
description_html:
Please note we are unable to support VISA and sponsorship for this role so you must have the right to work in the UK.

At Framestore’s Oscar-winning Technology team, innovation is at the heart of what we do, whether this be developing new techniques, new ideas or creative new ways to tell our clients’ stories. Underpinning all of this is a long tradition of research, technology and development - from engineering our bespoke software solutions to gaining early access to bleeding-edge technology and forging vibrant partnerships with leading academic and scientific institutions.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

About the Role

This is a new, hands-on role within our team. You’ll play a vital part in building the future of our cloud-first and machine learning strategies, writing the core software and automation that drives them. In this role, you will be actively developing high-availability automation workflows and building resilient big data pipelines that scale compute across the business. You will provide cloud and systems support for developers building complex agentic applications, while driving DevOps best practices to ensure our cloud services are built for the future.

You'll drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure by designing and implementing automation solutions that scale across the organisation. Your work will span cloud-native practices, machine learning infrastructure, and intelligent systems that keep our environment secure, resilient, and cost-effective.

What you’ll do:

  • Build highly available automation workflows and orchestrators that enable distributed builds, cross-platform compute scaling, and deployment of AI agents and data-heavy models

  • Design and implement event-driven automation and self-healing cloud systems that proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate infrastructure anomalies

  • Architect robust cloud security frameworks, identity management, and automated governance baselines across our global footprint

  • Design and optimise big data infrastructure for handling large metadata datasets and media assets, whilst identifying opportunities to reduce infrastructure spend without compromising performance


Essential Skills:

  • Experience designing high-availability, multi-environment cloud infrastructure using IaC (ideally Terraform) and container orchestration

  • Proven track record in the design and management of cloud-based data systems, such as Snowflake or BigQuery

  • A strong software background (ideally Python) with a proven track record of architecting scalable services and APIs

  • Ability to build, scale, and secure distributed automation pipelines (like GitLab CI) focusing on performance, caching, and testing frameworks

  • Experience supporting engineering teams, championing DevSecOps best practices, and collaborating with tech leadership

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between infrastructure engineering and development team workflows

Nice-to-have Skills:

  • Experience designing setups that span cloud providers and local physical servers

  • Knowledge of virtualisation of service applications

  • Advanced monitoring experience using tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or ELK.

  • A professional-level cloud certification

  • Production experience managing complex Kubernetes clusters and high-scale Docker environments.

  • Experience using advanced data platform features like vector embeddings, clustering, and analytics to enrich large-scale datasets

Accessibility Statement

Our London studio is fully accessible, with step-free entry, accessible toilets on all floors, and quiet spaces available. We are committed to supporting disabled colleagues and providing an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Application Process & Deadline

To apply, please complete the linked application form above by clicking the button or email your resume and portfolio to

We review all applications manually and do not use artificial intelligence to screen candidates. If you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please let us know - we are happy to accommodate your needs.

title: Senior O&M Asset Manager - Europe
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Sungrow Emea
description_html:
Your mission

Greetings, fellow seeker of sustainable futures! We're thrilled to present a pivotal role that connects cutting-edge technology with the operational excellence of renewable energy assets across Europe, the Senior O&M Asset Manager. Curious what this quest entails? Let's dive right in:

  • Hold senior accountability for the asset management of PV and ESS portfolios across Europe, ensuring compliance with LTSAs, SLAs, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Asset Managers, setting objectives, reviewing performance, and building capability.
  • Act as the senior escalation point and primary customer interface for complex technical, contractual, warranty, and corrective service issues.
  • Perform and oversee advanced contract analysis, identifying risks, obligations, and value optimization opportunities, and actively support LTSA negotiations.
  • Provide senior technical oversight by reviewing and validating Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), interpreting SCADA data, and assessing equipment logs.
  • Lead service partner performance management in collaboration with procurement and O&M teams, focusing on cost control, service quality, and contractual compliance.
  • Drive a data-driven asset management approach, including availability and performance analysis, spare parts strategy, and lifecycle cost optimization.
  • Ensure strong cross-functional coordination with Projects, Sales, Engineering, and HQ to support asset handover and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute directly to the profitability and long-term value of the O&M business through cost optimization, risk management, and performance-driven decision-making.
  • Champion continuous improvement in processes, reporting, asset performance, reliability, and team ways of working across the European asset management function.


Your profile

All right, all right, that was intriguing, wasn't it? Now, in order to fit in this role and be happy for a long time, your ideal background should look a lot like this:

  • A degree in engineering, business, contracting, or a related technical field is essential.
  • You possess a strong technical background in PV and Energy Storage (BESS) technologies.
  • Extensive experience in O&M asset management, handling complex asset portfolios and long-term service agreements is required.
  • Advanced expertise in contract analysis, including warranties, SLAs, penalties, liabilities, and risk allocation, is crucial.
  • You have a proven ability to review and validate RCAs, and to analyze SCADA data and equipment logs at a senior decision-making level.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, with the ability to set priorities, coach performance, and drive accountability is expected.
  • You exhibit strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with customers, internal teams, and service partners.
  • You are highly analytical, structured, and commercially minded, with a strong focus on profitability and value creation.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory, and proficiency in other languages is a plus.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word) is necessary, with advanced data analysis skills being an advantage.
  • You can operate effectively within a multicultural, matrix organization, with regular interaction with HQ and senior leadership.

  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung von Film- und Foto-Produktionen

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Kreativagentur, auf nationalen wie internationalen Marken und digitalem Background
  • Shooting-Erfahrung (Film & Foto)
  • Sicheres Gespür für Typografie und gute Gestaltung
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Souveräner Umgang mit den Programmen der Creative Suite
  • Ein Kopf, der voller kreativer Ideen steckt

Benefits

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit einem starken Team an deiner Seite
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • Vielseitiges Kundenspektrum mit großen Marken und international eingesetzten Kampagnen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit mobilem Arbeiten an zwei Tagen pro Woche und der Möglichkeit für Workation
  • 30 Urlaubstage und ein umfassendes Gesundheitsmanagement mit Sportkurs, Betriebsarzt und Vorsorgeangeboten
  • Täglich frisches Obst, Mineralwasser, Kaffee und Tee. Und nach Feierabend auch kühles Bierchen oder ein Glas Sekt.
  • Zentrale Lage mit unmittelbarer Nähe zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und für alle Sport-Fans: Bikeleasing

title: Key Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sine Engineering
description_html:
About Sine Engineering

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, delivering communication, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our solutions, and our technology powers many of the interceptor operations active today.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere. Resilient communication, navigation, and coordination built for the age of autonomy. Our products have already proven their effectiveness in real combat conditions in Ukraine.

Responsibilities

  • Build and expand Sine Engineering's customer and partner network across Germany.

  • Identify, engage, and develop strategic accounts across the defense, aerospace, UAV manufacturing, systems integration, robotics, electronics, telecommunications, RF, autonomy, and other related technology sectors.

  • Own the full sales cycle, including market mapping, prospecting, qualification, discovery, technical evaluation, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and long-term account growth.

  • Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes, technology partners, and relevant government-affiliated stakeholders.

  • Build direct relationships with senior executives and C-level decision-makers while developing strong engagement across engineering, program management, and procurement functions.

  • Position Sine Engineering effectively before formal procurement and tender processes begin.

  • Lead customer discussions related to communication modules, GNSS-denied navigation systems, video links, embedded autonomy software, and integration opportunities.

  • Coordinate technical evaluations, pilot projects, demonstrations, and integration discussions in collaboration with product and engineering teams.

  • Prepare commercial proposals, pricing structures, contract documentation, and partnership models.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, volume commitments, long-term agreements, and commercial frameworks.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM management, pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and account planning in line with European business operations.

  • Provide market intelligence regarding German defense procurement, competitors, customer requirements, funding priorities, and partnership opportunities.

  • Represent Sine Engineering at industry events, trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe.

  • Help establish scalable and repeatable sales processes for the German market and contribute to future team growth.

  • Work closely with the Managing Director Germany to ensure commercial account ownership and local market representation remain aligned and complementary.


    Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, strategic account management, or partnerships within a complex technical environment.

  • Proven track record of managing full-cycle sales processes with enterprise, industrial, defense, aerospace, or technology customers.

  • Strong understanding of long sales cycles, multi-stakeholder procurement processes, and complex commercial negotiations.

  • Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into clear business and technical requirements.

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering, product, operations, legal, and executive leadership teams.

  • Excellent commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive-level communication abilities.

  • Ability to work independently, proactively creating opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound leads.

  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, scale-up environment.

  • Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, collaborating with both a functional sales manager and a local managing director.

  • Based in Munich or willing to travel there regularly.

  • Willingness to travel frequently across Germany, Ukraine, and Europe.

    Nice to Have

  • Experience in the defense, aerospace, UAV, robotics, telecommunications, RF, or deep-tech sectors.

  • Experience building a market presence, territory, or sales function from an early stage.

  • Experience working with international teams, particularly across Germany and Eastern Europe.

  • Experience negotiating framework agreements and other long-term commercial partnerships.


Why Join Us?

If you're excited about building technology that shapes the future of drone autonomy and want your work to have a meaningful impact on defense and security, we'd love to hear from you.

If this role aligns with your experience and ambitions, don't hesitate to apply. We're looking for people who share our drive to push the boundaries of what's possible and deliver technologies that make a real-world difference.

title: Principal Database Performance Engineer - Core Engineering (C++)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Clickhouse
description_html:
NOTE: this role can be located anywhere ClickHouse has a hiring presence.

ClickHouse — Core Analytics Database

About the Role:
ClickHouse is looking for a Principal Database Performance Engineer to join the team behind our high-performance analytics database service.
In this role, you will drive performance and scalability improvements across the stack, taking on ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges most engineers never get to touch.
Our performance team owns the core of query execution - filters, aggregation, joins, and the index structures that make them fast.
We're looking for a sharp, passionate engineer who wants to own database performance end-to-end on a petabyte-scale cloud database, from initial analysis and implementation, through production rollout.

What you will do:
- Identify impactful performance and scalability opportunities in customer or benchmark workloads
- Architect and implement optimized database algorithms and data structures across core relational operators, indexes, query processing, memory management and scheduling
- Drive the performance roadmap for latency, throughput, memory efficiency and hardware utilization improvements
- Participate in the development of a complex, high-performance database system, including meticulous testing and safe production rollout
- Represent the company externally through presentations, blog posts, and community contributions
- Mentor and support junior engineers on the team

What You'll Bring
- 5+ years of experience in database performance engineering, distributed systems
- Master or PhD in databases or a related field
- Strong fluency in C++ and a background in performance-critical software or systems programming
- A track record of driving complex performance improvements end-to-end
- Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms
- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a proactive, goal-driven mindset

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

description_html:
About the Role

This is a founding senior attorney opportunity at an AI-native law firm in Germany, building the firm's client base and market presence from the ground up. You will bring an established portable book of business onto a proprietary agentic legal platform, acting as both a client-facing rainmaker and a key voice in shaping the firm's commercial growth. The role sits at the intersection of law practice and legal technology, and suits a senior practitioner who genuinely believes in the AI-driven future of legal services.

What You'll Do

  • Transition and continue serving your existing client book on the firm's AI agent platform.

  • Open top-of-funnel opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market network.

  • Cross-sell commercial and compliance legal services into your existing client base.

  • Collaborate with the founding team to move recurring matters onto the AI automation platform.

  • Help shape the firm's growth trajectory as a founding equity-holding partner.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 or more years of experience as a partner-level attorney at a top-ranked German law firm, with a focus on PE/VC and corporate sectors.

  • German-qualified Volljurist with active Rechtsanwalt bar admission.

  • A portable, personally held client book of €1M or more, weighted toward PE/VC clients and their portfolio companies.

  • Diversified client base across multiple sectors and company sizes, not dependent on a small number of large institutional clients for revenue.

  • Recurring, automatable work in your book such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate/VC advisory, or regulatory matters; not litigation-only.

  • Feasible transition path with a notice period and client migration achievable within approximately 6 months, and no restrictive non-competes preventing book portability.

  • Native-level German proficiency for client work and professional English fluency.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as large language model assistants or legal AI platforms in daily practice.

  • A Dr. iur. or LL.M. qualification is a plus.

  • Germany-based and fully work-authorized; no visa sponsorship is available.

Compensation & Benefits

Base compensation of €200,000 to €300,000 annually, plus meaningful equity in a technology-driven legal venture. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Germany-based, with Berlin in-person work preferred. Hybrid arrangement with flexibility for remote work.

title: Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tactiliarobotics
description_html:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

You design the mechanics of our robotic hands — from the kinematics of a single finger to a complete hand ready for series production.

Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline.

You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO.

What you will do:

  • CAD design. Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release.

  • Mechanism & kinematics. Design finger and thumb kinematics, tendon and spindle drives, joints and bearings. Calculate motion envelopes, trajectories, gripping forces and transmission ratios.

  • Calculation & validation. Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured.

  • Material selection. Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions.

  • Assembly design. Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling.

  • Design for manufacturing. Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset — machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing — balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes.

  • Prototyping & testing. Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause.

  • Documentation & release. Create drawings and BOMs, manage design changes and configuration, and support product development reviews.

  • Suppliers & production. Work with machine shops, material suppliers and manufacturing partners from first prototype through pilot series and production ramp-up.

  • Cross-functional integration. Work closely with Electronics, Sensors and Software to align packaging, interfaces and load paths across the complete system.

What you bring:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, precision engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5–10 years of experience in mechanical design of precision mechatronic products, including at least one product taken through to series production.

  • Advanced 3D CAD skills in CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo or comparable systems, with confident 2D drawing creation and GD&T.

  • Strong understanding of mechanism design: linkages, gear trains, bearings, shafts, power transmission, backlash and stiffness.

  • Experience with FEA, structural and fatigue analysis, and tolerance calculations as part of everyday design work.

  • Strong knowledge of material selection for lightweight, high-load and wear-critical components.

  • Practical DFM/DFA experience across multiple manufacturing processes.

  • Hands-on mentality — you build the prototype, run the test and analyse the broken part yourself.

  • Fluent in English and German.

Bonus:

  • Experience with robotic hands, grippers, prosthetics or similarly highly integrated mechanisms.

  • Experience with compact drive trains, including planetary, harmonic or cycloidal gearing, spindle drives and actuator integration.

  • Experience with elastomers, soft goods, injection moulding of complex geometries or compliant structures.

  • Experience integrating tactile or force sensors into mechanical structures.

  • Experience with multi-body simulation or topology optimisation.

  • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066 and mechanical design for collaborative applications.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. The Role

You are the bridge between a customer use case and our product. You take a task described on the shop floor, turn it into a working robot application, and translate what you learn back into concrete product requirements.

You work on humanoid and industrial platforms, in our lab and at customer sites. You are close to the hardware, responsible for making applications work in practice, and know whether a grasp still holds after ten thousand cycles.

You report to the CTO and work closely with Product, Software and Electronics.

What you will do:

  • Use case to requirement. Analyse customer applications on site, understand their technical and operational constraints, and derive specific, testable product requirements.

  • Skill implementation. Implement and optimise grasping and manipulation skills on real hardware — including parameterisation, grasp strategies, task sequences and error recovery.

  • Testing. Design and run application-level tests covering endurance, cycle testing, grasp success rates, robustness to object and position variance, and reproducibility.

  • High-level control & integration. Integrate our hands into humanoid and industrial robots, including mechanical and electrical interfacing, commissioning, task-level programming and sequencing.

  • Teleoperation & robot learning. Set up and operate teleoperation systems, record high-quality demonstrations for imitation learning, and support reinforcement-learning workflows including sim-to-real validation.

  • Demo setups & showcases. Build reliable demonstrators for trade fairs, customer visits and pilot projects that can run repeatedly under real-world conditions.

  • Shop floor deployment. Take applications from the lab into production environments, addressing cycle times, safety, system interfaces and integration with existing automation.

  • Feedback into development. Capture field findings, failure modes and product limitations and work with Product and Engineering to translate them into concrete improvements.

  • Documentation & enablement. Document applications, integration procedures and test results, and support customers and partners during deployment.

What you bring:

  • Degree in mechatronics, robotics, automation, mechanical or electrical engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 3–8 years of experience in robot applications, commissioning, systems integration or automation engineering.

  • Practical experience programming and commissioning industrial robots or cobots, with the confidence to work on live robotic cells.

  • Strong Python skills; C++ is an advantage.

  • Experience with ROS 2 and simulation environments such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo or comparable platforms.

  • Structured approach to testing — you design tests that produce measurable, reproducible results.

  • Hands-on mentality — you are comfortable building fixtures, wiring systems, commissioning hardware and running tests yourself.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites and trade fairs, approximately 20–30%.

  • Fluent in English and German.

Bonus:

  • Experience with grasping technology, end-of-arm tooling or dexterous manipulation.

  • Experience with teleoperation systems, motion capture or VR-based robot control.

  • Practical experience with imitation learning, behaviour cloning or reinforcement learning.

  • Experience with humanoid or mobile manipulation platforms.

  • Experience with machine vision and object detection in robotic applications.

  • Knowledge of risk assessment and safety for collaborative applications, including the Machinery Regulation and ISO/TS 15066.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.
