title: Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking (m/f/d)
description_html:
Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. As Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking, you are the technical owner of the entire program and you identify yourself with the success of this product: you set the technical direction, shape the system architecture, and turn customer needs into an integrated, executable delivery plan. You orchestrate the complete system, from base vehicle and autonomy hardware to the autonomy software stack and full system integration, and you drive it to maturity, primarily for defense logistics applications in regulated environments.

You work in an extremely tight partnership with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep one integrated plan that the whole organization can execute against.

This is a senior individual contributor role with maximum leverage: you align workstream leads, domain experts, truck OEM partners, and central functions into one integrated product and one executable delivery plan. You are the technical counterpart to Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, external stakeholder (OEMs), and the credible engineering voice towards senior leadership.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the Technical Program

    • Own the end-to-end technical orchestration of our autonomous trucking program with strong focus on integration, execution readiness, and delivery reliability.

    • Define and maintain the integrated technical roadmap: milestones, dependencies, and critical path from development through deployment, performance, and certification goals.

    • Identify integration gaps, decision bottlenecks, and execution risks early; escalate with judgement and propose solution options

    • Ensure technical trade-offs are transparent and made consciously across product, engineering, and operations.

  • Drive System Integration to series industrialisation and production

    • Align technical integration and ensure convergence across base vehicle, autonomy hardware stack, autonomy software stack (modular and End2End planner approaches), verification and validation, ground operations and test, and systems engineering including safety and security.

    • Drive technical maturity from subsystem status to validated system behavior; ensure interfaces are clear, owned, and validated between the teams

    • Push for integration planning with the right cadence of reviews, demos, test evidence, and decision points.

  • Partner with Product Management

    • Work in an extremely tight loop with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how and by when we deliver it in lockstep alignment with engineering management.

    • Translate product intent into technical execution clarity; challenge unclear scope, unclear priorities, or missing system implications early.

title: Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d)

description_html:
As a Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d), you will be the central point of control for all software delivery activities across multiple software engineering teams. You will oversee feature development progress, manage release schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software for our advanced drone systems.

You will coordinate daily operations, manage tickets and workflow, and act as the decision-maker when priorities conflict, always keeping delivery commitments on track. This roles requires a mix of technical understanding of software architecture, organizational skills and assertive leadership. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones.

You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development and product management). By ensuring timely software deliveries, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the release process for all software components, including embedded firmware, ground control software, and AI mission packages.

  • Monitor and track development progress across multiple teams, ensuring alignment with release timelines.

  • Manage configuration and version control for all software artifacts and environments.

  • Lead daily stand-ups and coordination meetings, driving clarity and accountability.

  • Maintain and prioritize the backlog, ensuring tickets are properly managed and resolved.

  • Act as the decision authority when trade-offs are needed to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Define and enforce release policies, including branching strategies, quality gates, and approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (engineering, QA, product management) to ensure smooth and predictable releases.

  • Continuously improve release processes, introducing automation and best practices where possible.



What you bring to the team:

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5+ years of experience in software release management, configuration management, or similar roles.

  • Proven experience in managing projects and leading teams.

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (GitLab/GitHub), and branching strategies.

  • Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) and agile methodologies.

  • Familiarity with embedded software development and multi-component systems.

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to make tough decisions under pressure.

  • Experience with DO-178C is advantageous.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Proactive, organized and a team player mindset

  • Ability to balance multiple assignments


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

description_html:
Dein neues Team:

Du willst verstehen, wie Forderungsverkauf, Partnersteuerung und saubere Prozesskontrollen in der Praxis zusammenspielen? Im Bereich NPL & Partnermanagement verantworten wir die operativen Abläufe rund um den Forderungsverkauf und die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Partnern. Dabei sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere NPL- und Partnerprozesse zuverlässig, datenbasiert und revisionssicher dokumentiert laufen. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du uns im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitest eng mit internen Schnittstellen sowie externen Partnern zusammen.


Das erwartet Dich:

  • Monitoring & IKS: Du unterstützt beim Monitoring laufender NPL- und Partnerprozesse sowie bei monatlichen IKS-Kontrollen und dokumentierst Nachweise nachvollziehbar in unseren internen Systemen.
  • Zahlungsverbuchung & Reporting: Du spielst Zahlungen in unsere interne Inkasso-Software ein, führst Kontrollen und Abgleiche durch und erstellst Zahlungsberichte.
  • Datenchecks & Abgleiche: Du führst vordefinierte SQL-Checks aus, passt diese bei Bedarf minimal an und erstellst Grundgesamtheiten inklusive CSV-Exporten sowie Duplikats-, Schnittmengen- und Plausibilitätsprüfungen.
  • Forderungsverkauf & Rückabwicklung: Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und operativen Abwicklung von Forderungsverkäufen an Debt Collection Agencies (DCAs), bearbeitest definierte Sonderfälle, begleitest Prozess- und Dateitransfers und dokumentierst Vorgänge sauber im Ticket-System.
  • Partnerabstimmung & Nachverfolgung: Du stimmst Dich mit unserer Partnerbank SWK, den DCAs sowie intern mit IT ab, klärst Rückfragen und hältst offene Punkte konsequent nach.
  • DCA-Statistiken & Präsentation: Du bereitest DCA-Statistiken auf und unterstützt bei deren Vorstellung.
  • Maximale Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid mit einem festen Präsenztag pro Woche in Düsseldorf und ansonsten im Homeoffice innerhalb Deutschlands.


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Studium: Du bist aktuell in einem Studium der BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit Daten, Reports oder operativen Abläufen gesammelt, zum Beispiel durch Praktika, eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder eine Ausbildung, und idealerweise bringst Du erste SQL-Kenntnisse mit.
  • Struktur & Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest zuverlässig, sorgfältig und strukturiert und übernimmst Aufgaben eigenständig.
  • Datenaffinität: Du hast Freude an Zahlen, Tabellen und Listen und ein gutes Verständnis für Abgleiche und Plausibilitätsprüfungen.
  • Tool-Sicherheit: Du verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Excel, und findest Dich schnell in neuen Systemen zurecht.
  • Kommunikation: Du bereitest Themen klar und übersichtlich auf und kommunizierst gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnerinnen und Ansprechpartner.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Das bringen wir mit:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte Deinen Arbeitstag so, dass er optimal zu Deinem Studium passt – wir unterstützen Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse!
  • Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Homeoffice: Arbeite dort, wo Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst. Ob im Büro oder von zu Hause – Du entscheidest!
  • Flache Hierarchien: Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Du hast direkten Kontakt zu Entscheidungsträgern und kannst Deine Ideen einbringen.
  • Vielfältige Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Du hast die Chance, Deine eigenen Projekte zu leiten und Deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Zahlreiche bereichsübergreifende Events: Knüpfe wertvolle Kontakte und erlebe unser Team bei spannenden Veranstaltungen und Teamevents.
  • Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club: Bleib fit und gesund – wir fördern Dein Wohlbefinden mit attraktiven Fitnessangeboten!
  • Täglich frisches Obst, endlos Kaffee, Tee und Wasser: Genieße eine gesunde Snack- und Getränkebar, die Dir hilft, energisch durch den Tag zu kommen.
  • Rabatte über Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Angeboten und Rabatten auf zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen – ein zusätzliches Plus für Deinen Geldbeutel!
Schließe Dich unserem Team an und bewirb Dich noch heute! Vergiss nicht, uns Dein voraussichtliches Ende des Studiums, Deinen gewünschten Stundenlohn sowie Dein nächstmögliches Startdatum mitzuteilen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Deine Bewerbung zu erhalten!

Für uns als Arbeitgeber sind Chancengleichheit und Diversität besonders wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns auf Bewerbungen von Müttern, Vätern, Menschen mit Behinderungen und Menschen aus der LGBTQIA+ Community. Bitte teile uns gerne mit, wenn wir z.B. ein geschlechtsneutrales Pronomen verwenden sollen, Du einen barrierefreien Zugang zu unserem Büro benötigst oder wir mehr Zeit für den Bewerbungsprozess einplanen sollen.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Auxmoney Gmbh
description_html:
Your new team:

Would you like to build Salesforce solutions that directly improve the experience of thousands of customers? At auxmoney, you will join a dynamic, cross functional team with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and a 360 degree view of the customer journey. You will work at the intersection of tech, product, and business, shaping scalable platform capabilities and reliable workflows that support one of Europe’s leading fintech platforms.


What you can expect:

  • Own end to end delivery: You architect, implement, and maintain high quality Salesforce solutions across Apex, Flows, LWC, and data models, and you take technical ownership from design to release.
  • Build strong architectures: You apply clean architecture, testability, and performance best practices, and you raise the bar for maintainable code across the platform.
  • Deliver great Salesforce UX: You design and optimize Lightning Web Components with strong performance, thoughtful interaction patterns, and a focus on usable, scalable experiences.
  • Secure by design: You implement robust security and sharing concepts aligned with Salesforce’s security model, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field level security.
  • Integrate with confidence: You design and implement integrations via REST and SOAP, platform events, and connectors with resilient patterns, strong authentication, and thorough error handling.
  • Optimize for scale: You build within Salesforce governor limits and enforce best practices for bulkification, caching, transaction management, and async processing.
  • Raise engineering standards: You define and champion platform standards, coding conventions, code reviews, and design guidelines as a trusted technical authority.
  • Mentor and multiply impact: You coach junior and mid level developers through pair programming, structured knowledge sharing, and pragmatic guidance that improves team output.
  • Partner across stakeholders: You collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Operations to translate complex business needs into scalable technical designs and delivery plans.
  • Test for trust: You set expectations for meaningful unit and integration testing, and you help the team maintain strong, reliable coverage that supports safe delivery.
  • Keep the platform reliable: You strengthen observability and maintainability through documentation, architectural decision records, and practical knowledge sharing.
  • Work setup: You will work remotely within Germany, with collaboration routines that keep delivery fast, aligned, and transparent.


Your profile

  • Seasoned Salesforce development: You bring extensive hands on Salesforce development experience (8+ years) in enterprise environments and a track record of delivering impact at scale.
  • Technical leadership: You are advanced in Flows and highly proficient in Apex and OOP, and you confidently choose the right approach across Flow, Apex, and configuration.
  • Strong LWC expertise: You have deep experience with Lightning Web Components, including lifecycle, reactivity, performance optimization, and UI and UX best practices.
  • Security and compliance mindset: You understand Salesforce’s security and sharing model and design for least privilege from the start.
  • Integration skills: You connect Salesforce to external systems via REST and SOAP, OAuth, and named or external credentials, and you select suitable integration patterns for complex scenarios.
  • Built for scale: You consistently apply best practices in governor limits, bulkification, transactions, async processing, and error handling, and you help others do the same.
  • Delivery discipline: You work fluently with Git and pull requests, and you have hands on experience with CI and CD for Salesforce, for example Salesforce DX and GitHub Actions.
  • Clear communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly in English and collaborate effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Nice to have: You bring German skills, Salesforce certifications such as PD I or PD II, Architect track progress, and experience with managed packages, platform events, and Data Loader or ETL.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.
Your perspective: You will shape how auxmoney builds and scales its Salesforce platform by owning end to end delivery and influencing technical standards. Your work will directly improve reliability, speed, and quality across customer facing and operational processes. You will grow your impact through mentoring and by helping define future architecture decisions.

At auxmoney, we’re committed to equal opportunity and diversity. We especially welcome applications from parents, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if you’d like us to use gender-neutral pronouns, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you require more time during the application process.

title: Strategic Account Executive (m/f/d)

description_html:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As Strategic Account Executive (m/f/d), you are responsible for sustainably expanding the structure of the Authorized DocuWare Partner (ADP) network and supporting DocuWare software sales. In this role, you implement the solution selling approach and promote these strategies within the partner network.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Meeting or exceeding sales quotas established during target-setting discussions and by management.
  • Developing business opportunities via the partner channel, including creating and implementing marketing plans and collaborating with other departments to identify new business prospects.
  • Actively supporting our partners with lead qualification and leveraging your own closing skills to help secure partner deals.
  • Conducting sales workshops, training sessions, end-user webinars, and customer presentations to educate partners and close deals.
  • Acquiring new partners and expanding the partner network.
  • Handling monthly administrative tasks (such as CRM updates and report uploads) and communicating the results to management.
  • Demonstrating your sales expertise by identifying opportunities and independently managing them from initial contact and the pre-sales phase through to a successful close.


What you need to succeed

  • You have several years of professional experience in sales - specifically with document management, business, accounting, or ERP software. DocuWare certifications are a plus.
  • You possess strong presentation and communication skills when interacting with customers, sales staff, and various other stakeholders.
  • You have excellent IT skills and the ability to competently demonstrate software functions and their benefits.
  • Your skillset also includes analyzing business processes and identifying tailored solutions.
  • Furthermore, you have excellent verbal and written German skills. A very high level of proficiency in spoken and written English rounds out your profile.
  • A high willingness to travel is required. You also enjoy leading and motivating people.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.
  • Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.
  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • Up to 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferential registration in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
For better insights, check us out on Instagram!

Recruiting & Employer Branding Specialist

title: Head of Business Operations / Senior Business Operations Manager - all genders welcome!
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Vicegolf
description_html:
About the Job

Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Head of Business Operations or Senior Business Operations Manager to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. In this role, you help translate our revenue targets into an operational plan and bring five independent teams together along this plan. You are the central interface for planning, timing, and alignment in the revenue and marketing area, holding everything together. Ready to embrace your Vice?


Skip the copy paste. Show us your swing

Your CV tells us what you’ve done. We want to understand why those experiences make you the right person for this role. So make your application your own: tailor your CV, tell us about your most relevant achievement, or surprise us with a short presentation. This isn’t a design contest, we’re interested in how you think, what you bring to the table, and what you want to achieve at Vice.


Your Fairway

  • Break down monthly and quarterly D2C targets into weekly and daily targets with specific references to products and promotional campaigns
  • Develop target proposals for C-level executives, who will approve the final plan
  • Maintain the product and promotional calendar, taking processes and deadlines into account
  • Ensuring lead times across five teams (E-commerce & UX, CRM, Performance Marketing, Brand & Marketing, Tech) and identifying and resolving deviations early on
  • Leading the weekly trading review
  • Analyzing problems and developing solutions together with the teams
  • Supporting the expansion of planning to additional sales channels (Green Grass, Specialty Retail, Amazon, etc.)
  • Making independent decisions regarding promotional calendars, discounts, and team prioritization; final decisions regarding budget, pricing, and P&L remain the responsibility of our C-level


Your Scorecard

  • Commercial numerical understanding and judgment rather than pure reporting of numbers

  • Fluency in spoken and written German and English

  • Several years of professional experience (3+ years) in business operations, consulting, chief of staff, commercial, and program management, or comparable experience in complex organizational areas is preferred

  • A background in performance marketing, content, or e-commerce technology is an asset but not a requirement

  • Organizational talent to bring five teams together, identify dependencies early on, and ensure alignment before a gap turns into a problem

  • Critical mindset to challenge the status quo, contribute your own ideas, and actively help shape the future rather than just following plans

  • Structured thinking with foresight

  • Strong communication skills to convince experienced team leads on an equal footing and think creatively with them about the future, while still giving them the space to apply their technical expertise

  • A passion for golf is a plus, but not a requirement 


Note: We use Artificial Intelligence to support this process; the final decision still remains with a human.


Our Clubhouse

  • We embrace diversity and innovation. Our motley team comes from all backgrounds and perspectives, united by fresh and bold ideas.

  • Taking ownership from day one. Our ambitious vision relies on every individual stepping up to bring Vice Golf to the next level.

  • Make your work hours fit your life. Flexible work arrangements and remote work options cater to your work-life balance.

  • Grow with us. We place great emphasis on your personal development, where you benefit from not only regular performance feedback but also an annual training budget.

  • Escape the routine. Within the EU, you’re free to choose your workspace for two weeks a year.

  • Stay active. We’re invested in your well-being, subsidizing EGYM Wellpass so you can train for only 30 € a month.

  • Enjoy! Fuel your day with a varied selection of fresh meals and snacks from our Foodji.

  • Secure your (far) future! While retirement might seem distant to you, we’ve got you covered with options to enroll in our corporate pension plan.

  • Work hard play hard. Work on your golf skills and refine your swing on the state-of-the-art golf simulator and putting green in our office.

  • Enjoy the open bar. Have some Afterwork drinks on our rooftop while enjoying the view of the Alps.

title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Baramundi Software Ag
description_html:
Welcome to baramundi!

“Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”

Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features.


Do what you do best:

  • DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
  • TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
  • DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
  • BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
  • COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
  • USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.


What we appreciate about you:

  • Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
  • Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
  • Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
  • Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
  • Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
  • Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
  • Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.


Meet us!


10 reasons to choose baramundi!

#1 ARRIVE IN PEACE
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

#2 FEEL AT HOME
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

#3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

#4 GET REWARDED
You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

#5 ENJOY LIFE
Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible working hours in full or part-time, home office, and even sabbatical options.

#6 STAY HEALTHY
We want you to feel good. That’s why we have ergonomic furniture and organize health days, massages, yoga, and running groups.

#7 DEVELOP FURTHER
Your personal and professional advancement is important to us. We pay for training and coaching during working hours. Even two-year work stays at our branch in the USA are possible.

#8 WORK AT EYE LEVEL
We are all on a first-name basis, from apprentices to management. We don’t have complicated hierarchies.

#9 YOUR FAMILY IS IMPORTANT TO US
Family means being there, caring, and supporting each other. We do this with daycare subsidies and holiday care, as well as at our family summer festival.

#10 MAKE US EVEN BETTER
We want to be a great place and employer. For that, we need honest feedback.


Contact us!

title: Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d)

description_html:
Wir suchen dich!

Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten Sales Development (m/w/d), der uns dabei unterstützt, noch mehr Unternehmen für bessere Kundenkommunikation zu begeistern.

Jeden Tag helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation einfacher, effizienter und besser zu gestalten. Damit noch mehr Unternehmen von unseren Lösungen profitieren können, möchten wir unseren Kundenstamm gezielt erweitern und neue Kontakte aufbauen.

Du hast Freude daran, dich in Unternehmen einzulesen, die richtigen Ansprechpartner zu identifizieren und den ersten Kontakt herzustellen? Du bist neugierig, kommunizierst gerne und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus der Ruhe bringen? Dann passt du zu uns.

Vorerfahrungen im Vertrieb sind dabei kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du Interesse an Menschen, Unternehmen und guter Kommunikation mitbringst. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team. Nach deiner Einarbeitung kannst du überwiegend remote arbeiten. Für Trainings, Feedbackgespräche, Teamtage oder andere wichtige Termine freuen wir uns, wenn du nach Absprache an einem unserer Standorte dabei bist.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du recherchierst Unternehmen, die zu unseren Zielkunden passen.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Ansprechpartner und pflegst Informationen in unserem CRM.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache potenzieller Kunden per E-Mail, Telefon und LinkedIn.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche mit Interessenten und prüfst gemeinsam mit dem Team, ob ein passender Bedarf besteht.
  • Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unser Vertriebsteam.
  • Du dokumentierst Aktivitäten und Erkenntnisse sauber in unseren Systemen.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ansprachesequenzen weiter und testest, welche Ansätze gut funktionieren.
  • Du gibst Rückmeldungen aus Gesprächen und Recherchen an Vertrieb und Marketing weiter. 


Deine Rolle bei uns

  • Du bist kein Praktikant im Hintergrund, sondern Teil unseres Vertriebsteams.
  • Du lernst, wie moderne Neukundengewinnung im B2B-Umfeld funktioniert, übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und arbeitest eng mit unseren Vertriebskollegen zusammen.
  • Wenn du langfristig im Vertrieb arbeiten möchtest, kannst du dich bei uns perspektivisch in Richtung Sales Development Representative oder Account Executive weiterentwickeln.


Dein Profil

Must-haves

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben.
  • Du kommunizierst gerne mit anderen Menschen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenverantwortlich.
  • Du bist neugierig und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein.
  • Du hast keine Scheu davor, aktiv auf Menschen zuzugehen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Nice-to-haves
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, Service, Vertrieb, Recruiting oder einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit.
  • Interesse an Vertrieb, Software, Digitalisierung oder Kundenservice.
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit LinkedIn, CRM-Systemen oder anderen digitalen Tools.

Wir suchen dich!

Unternehmen erwarten heute, dass ihre Kunden schnell den richtigen Ansprechpartner erreichen und Anliegen ohne Umwege geklärt werden können. Genau dabei unterstützen wir sie.

Für den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs suchen wir einen Account Executive (m/w/d), der neue Kunden gewinnt und sie dabei begleitet, ihre Kundenkommunikation einfacher, effizienter und besser zu gestalten.

Du arbeitest dich gerne in die Abläufe und Herausforderungen eines Unternehmens ein, bevor du über Produkte sprichst? Du führst Gespräche auf Augenhöhe, denkst in Lösungen und möchtest aktiv zum Wachstum eines Unternehmens beitragen? Dann suchen wir dich.

Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team.

title: Chief of Staff
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at deeploi - This is IT
description_html:
Your mission

We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Chief of Staff (f/m/d) to join the leadership team at deeploi.

In this role, you act as a strategic and operational partner to the CEO, driving cross-functional alignment, owning our financial steering, and making sure decisions are taken and executed across the company.

You combine sharp financial judgment with organisational excellence, acting as a bridge between strategy, finance and execution, as we build deeploi into a company with sustainable, profitable growth.

This is a highly visible role with a wide scope. Wherever a topic matters and has no clear home, you take it, own it end to end, and drive it to a result. You set a high bar for yourself and the people around you.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own strategic projects: Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from first structure to final delivery.
  • Shape our commercial model: Drive how we position, package and price our product as we expand our SaaS offering and open up new go-to-market tiers.
  • Lead financial steering & reporting: Own business planning, forecasts, investor reporting and performance tracking, as well as accounting, billing and our external finance partners.
  • Structure how we run: Drive OKRs, decision-making and cross-functional collaboration for clarity and accountability, shape the formats that hold the team together and, together with People, connect company OKRs to performance management and feedback.
  • Partner with leadership: Act as a trusted thought partner to the Founders and the leadership team, including sparring on People initiatives.
  • Own legal & contracts: Take responsibility for customer contracts and contractual updates, coordinate external legal support, manage our public funding topics and drive our ISO topics.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of experience in consulting, investment or strategic and finance roles in a startup or scale-up, for example as a Chief of Staff, in a founder’s office, or in a senior finance role.
  • Strong background in financial analysis, reporting and planning, and confident in Excel modelling. Specialist accounting expertise is not required.
  • A real appetite to grab topics, take full accountability and drive them end to end, without waiting for someone to hand you a plan. You own what is unclear, unowned, and what everyone avoids.
  • Hands-on and entrepreneurial, with the detail orientation to push until something is excellent and the standards to raise the bar around you.
  • Excellent strategic thinking and communication: you translate between strategy, finance and operations, and challenge constructively at senior level.
  • Comfortable in a high performance culture with fast pace, changing priorities and broad responsibility.
  • High integrity, trustworthiness and discretion in handling sensitive information.
  • Fluent German (ideally C2) and business fluent English (C1).
  • You are in our Berlin office 3 to 4 days a week, and you make in-person culture something people want, not something they comply with.


Why us?

  • A key role in the leadership team with real ownership, impact and visibility, working directly alongside both Founders on the topics that decide where deeploi goes next.
  • Join a B2B SaaS company backed by Atomico, Cherry Ventures and other leading investors.
  • Competitive compensation package including virtual equity (VSOP).
  • Well-equipped offices in Berlin and Munich, plus benefits such as Urban Sports Club/EGYM or a public transport ticket and Corporate Benefits.
  • A team culture that is ambitious, transparent and collaborative, where ownership meets impact.

title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Aroundhome
description_html:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth.

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.
  • You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes.


Skills

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).
  • Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics.
  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 


What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

Transparency // We want to be transparent, also when it comes to salary: If you have any questions about a possible salary range for this position, feel free to send us an email at ----- We will get back to you as soon as possible.

The ILF Solar Photovoltaic & hybrid systems team works across a vast range of large-scale renewables projects and programs, both grid connected and off-grid across private and public sectors globally. We offer you to join a dynamic environment and to work on unique and exciting projects (including floating PV, complex hybrid systems, combination with Hydrogen, rural electrification, etc.).

Join our Team in Munich or Fontainebleau / Paris to contribute to the transition toward a decarbonized and sustainable energy future!
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D)


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • You will operate as a Senior Project Manager - Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) for strategic projects worldwide. Your clients will include International Finance Institutions (AFD, KfW, World Bank, EBRD, EIB, etc.), national power utilities, major private clients (industrial, project developers, etc.).

  • During development phase of the projects, you will lead Feasibility studies of complex power plant systems including system sizing / optimization, CAPEX and OPEX estimation, conceptual / detail design and layout, grid studies (PSS/E, Power Factory), energy master plan studies (PLEXOS, PyPSA), etc. Your activities could also include to lead TDD, LTA as well as Technical Transaction Advisor projects.

  • During implementation phase, you will lead the tender design, evaluation of EPC/IPP offers, reviewing and validating the executive design before construction (design vetting). Your will also be overseeing the supervision of the construction, commissioning and O&M phase.

  • As an interface between suppliers, IPP / EPC contractors and clients you keep up to date with and pass on market trends, technology development, new products, standards and simulation models.

  • Your engineering skills will contribute to the standardization of work processes with the goal of enhancing efficiency and quality.

  • You will also support the development of our international activities by preparing proposals and supporting business development initiatives.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Graduated in the field of energy, electrical engineering or similar with a focus on Renewable Energies / Photovoltaics / Energy Storage Systems (ESS).

  • At least 10 years of experience in large scale photovoltaic & battery systems with robust project management and engineering skills. Expertise in Wind and Green Hydrogen projects would be a plus.

  • Experience with Energy software such as PVSyst, HOMER PRO, and/or Power system Software (Power Factory, PSS/E) is required.

  • Understanding of technical aspects of PPA and EPC contracts regarding performance and penalties is required.

  • Excellent writing skills

  • Very good written and spoken skills in English and in French.


91% of our employees consider ILF Germany & France a “Great Place to Work”.

 

  • Friendly company culture and diversity in everyday practice

    Numerous local and cross-regional events strengthen team spirit, and the majority of our employees address each other on a first-name basis. We are particularly proud of the international diversity of our teams, which bring together more than 30 nationalities.

  • Modern working environment

    Across all our locations, our employees benefit from modern, high-quality workstations, including height-adjustable desks.

  • Professional development and networking

    Every employee receives an annual training budget that can be used for external learning platforms (such as Udemy) as well as our internal ILF Academy. Regular development discussions provide opportunities to explore new responsibilities and career development paths. Young engineers also meet regularly through the Young Engineers Club.

  • Benefits beyond salary

    We share the company’s success with our employees and reward candidate referrals, technical publications, and conference presentations with attractive bonuses. Outstanding achievements are recognized through our Excellence Awards. In addition, employees can choose between a Pluxee benefits card and supplementary health insurance.

  • International environment and diversity

    As part of the ILF Group, which is still managed by its founding families and operates in more than 45 locations worldwide with over 3,700 employees, we work on national and international projects in multicultural teams representing more than 30 nationalities.

  • Work-life balance

    We offer flexible solutions tailored to individual needs, both in terms of working hours (flexible schedules, part-time options) and work location (remote work, mobility between offices, and international assignments).

  • Health and sustainability

    We subsidize public transportation costs and offer a bicycle leasing program. Through our Employee Assistance Program, employees can receive fast and professional support for both personal and work-related matters.

 

Convinced?

Then join Engineering Excellence and submit your application by clicking the button below!

 

Do you have any questions?

Learn more about our company and our application process here.

title: Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Institut Mines-Télécom
description_html:
🚀 Rejoignez une institution d’excellence et d’innovation en tant qu’Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de recherche en intelligence artificielle appliquée à la vision industrielle 3D, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, innovation technologique et transfert vers l’industrie,   affecté(e) au Centre Fayol de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

Au sein de ce centre de recherche pluridisciplinaire (plus de 80 personnes), reconnu pour son expertise en IA, systèmes cyber-physiques et sciences des données, vous contribuerez à des projets de R&D à fort impact pour l’industrie du futur. Le centre s’appuie notamment sur sa plateformes technologiques IT'M Factory et est un acteur-clé de l'enseignement et de l'innovation au sein de l’Institut Mines-Télécom.

 

Dans le cadre du projet régional DIGIMAN3D, financé par la Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, ce recrutement vise à développer et expérimenter une solution de contrôle dimensionnel 3D en ligne, basée sur l’acquisition de données 3D et l’intelligence artificielle, pour le contrôle automatisé de pièces mécaniques de précision en conditions industrielles.

 

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

· Vous assurez le développement et l’adaptation d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle appliqués aux données 3D et aux nuages de points, notamment pour la segmentation géométrique, l’identification des surfaces et la sélection des données pertinentes pour la mesure.

· Vous participez à la qualification des capteurs 3D et à la mise en place du banc d’essai expérimental, ainsi qu’aux campagnes d’acquisition et de caractérisation des données dans des environnements représentatifs des conditions industrielles.

· Vous contribuez au développement d’une chaîne hybride associant intelligence artificielle et méthodes géométriques analytiques, afin d’améliorer la précision, la robustesse et la répétabilité des mesures dimensionnelles, avec un objectif de précision inférieur à 20 µm.

· Vous participez à l’intégration et à l’évaluation des modèles développés sur banc d’essai, puis sur machine à commande numérique et en conditions réelles de production, en collaboration avec les partenaires du consortium.

· Vous rendez compte de vos travaux par des rapports techniques, des résultats expérimentaux, des démonstrateurs fonctionnels et des interactions régulières avec les partenaires scientifiques et industriels du projet.

 

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet, à interagir avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à faire dialoguer recherche, développement et application industrielle sera essentielle pour réussir.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

·  Diplôme Bac +5 (école d’ingénieur ou master 2) en science de données, informatique, intelligence artificielle, traitement d’image.

 

Et idéalement :

· Avec une expérience de 1 à 3 ans dans le secteur de l’intelligence artificielle appliquée, notamment à des projets en vision par ordinateur, segmentation, ou détection d’anomalies.

Et vous possédez :

• Une expérience significative en développement d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle ou de vision par ordinateur.

• Une expérience confirmée en programmation Python avec des bibliothèques IA (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV)

• Une expertise avérée en apprentissage non supervisé ou auto-supervisé, détection d’anomalies

• Une maîtrise de l’anglais technique (niveau B2 confirmé)

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

·  Connaissances en intégration sur matériel industriel (edge computing, GPU, PC embarqué)

·  Intérêt pour la transfert technologique et l'impact industriel concret

📩 Candidatez dès maintenant !

Date limite de candidature :  16/10/2026

ℹ️ Informations complémentaires

  • Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 24 mois

  • Localisation du poste : Saint-Étienne (42).

  • Rémunération fixée selon le profil du candidat, en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom.

  • Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap.

  • Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique (catégorie A - détaché sur contrat) et/ou aux personnes contractuelles.

  • À moyen terme, un poste pérenne est susceptible d’être ouvert.

  • Toute candidature peut faire l’objet d’une enquête administrative

Les candidats présélectionnés après examen de leur dossier seront convoqués à un entretien à Saint-Étienne ou à distance en visioconférence (le lien de connexion sera communiqué ultérieurement).

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

  • Un soutien à l’intégration : indépendamment de la participation à nos projets de recherche, l’Institut Henri Fayol vous assure les moyens financiers pour présenter vos travaux à 1 conférence internationale et un stagiaire en soutien.

  • Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

title: UX/UI Designer M/W/X
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Veepee
description_html:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.
 

Veepee is looking for a UX/UI Designer for its Growth Marketing team. Attached to the Lead of UX/UI, the person in this position will be responsible for executing the UX vision for the Veepee front experience. You will ensure the optimization of the customer journey across all Veepee sites by analyzing the performance of each step in the user path.

🎯 TASKS

 

UX/UI Vision and Strategy

  • Deliver the UX/UI front vision for all Veepee sites and apps in collaboration with marketing, business, and Tech teams.

  • Ensure a flawless and coherent user experience across all devices.

  • Contribute to the performance improvement of Veepee platforms by monitoring defined KPIs and business value.

  • Propose best practices and innovative solutions to address e-commerce challenges, specifically the flash sales model.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of the group Design System.

Collaboration Business - Tech

  • Work closely with Business and Product Tech teams to design UX/UI solutions that balance business expectations with technical complexity.

  • Maintain the quality of business requests and technical deliveries to ensure high-performing evolutions.

  • Support the definition of Tech Roadmaps and the prioritization of projects through design validation and delivery.

Team Contribution

  • Participate actively in team rituals and collaborative planning to ensure a performing organization.

  • Maintain high-quality deliveries and stay updated with the latest UX/UI trends and innovations.

👉 MUST HAVE skills

  • At least 3 years of experience as a UX/UI Designer, with a main focus on e-commerce environments.

  • Proactive, organized, and autonomous in moving projects forward.

  • Strong understanding of the e-commerce universe, particularly platforms with high daily traffic volumes.

  • Results-oriented with a capacity to identify and improve process weaknesses.

  • Comfortable working with a wide range of departments, including IT, Data Science, Legal, and Finance.

  • Fluent level of English is a must.

  • International experience is a plus.

❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ? 

  • The Marketing Growth team is dedicated to acquiring new customers, retaining existing customers and improving the user experience on all channels

  • You will join a team of 5 UX/UI designers plus a Lead UX/UI, 1 Head of SEO; 2 BPOs (definition of the business needs); and 1 Product analyst.

  • We are the owner of the Front roadmaps and SEO strategy at a group level, coordinating and consolidating inputs from a wide range of different teams, from IT teams to Data science, legal, finance, logistics, commercial or operational; and leading several initiatives from the Group

We are convinced that it is up to you to define the way you work, to develop yourself and to progress. At Veepee we guarantee that you can just be yourself! For the service of diversity and inclusion, Veepee is committed to reviewing all applications received on an equal basis.
 
The Veepee Group processes your data collected as part of the management of your recruitment in order to manage your application file for the position for which you have applied. To find out more about our , we invite you to consult it on our career site.
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Pflegia
description_html:
At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis.

We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us.

Tasks

What You'll Do

  • Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks.
  • Analyze business requirements and break them down into roadmaps, timelines, epics, tickets and tasks — and defend the cut list.
  • Document, analyze and improve the whole user journey on both sides of the marketplace: candidates and employers have competing interests, and those trade-offs are yours to make rather than escalate.
  • Create actionable concepts for new products and features, estimate effort and ROI, own the process from ideation to delivery.
  • Decide where AI belongs and where it does not. Run experiments with the expected outcome written down first, then verify and iterate.
  • Define KPIs, track them, improve them, revise them. Within 90 days we expect one metric you moved, with a baseline, a number, and a read you can defend to the leadership team.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, developers and the data team, and use data-driven storytelling to align them.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership/Management, shipping with cross-functional agile teams.
  • Experience building or scaling marketplaces, job boards, or recruitment platforms — two-sided funnels behave differently and we would rather not teach that from scratch.
  • Data-driven by default: you write your own analytics questions, read an experiment result, and say "this did not work" out loud. Analytics, A/B testing, experimentation.
  • Strong ability to define product vision, roadmaps and priorities against business goals, customer needs and technical constraints — including clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for complicated workflows and funnels.
  • Excellent written German and English. Our users, employers and support team are German-speaking; our codebase and documentation are English.

Nice to have

  • Search and SEO, including the AI-answer variants (AIEO, AEO, GEO) — a growing share of our traffic.
  • Matching or recommendation systems: you know why offline metrics and business metrics disagree.
  • Healthcare hiring workflows and empathy for the field — shift work, qualification recognition, and why a nurse does not read email at 14:00.
  • SQL. Not required, but the people who enjoy this role usually have it.

Benefits

  • Decision authority. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths are not a slogan here: you will not need a committee to ship, and you will not get to blame one either.
  • Direct access to the data — our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics. You query it yourself instead of filing a ticket and waiting.
  • Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front.
  • Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership.
  • An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere.
  • Central Berlin office in a beautiful old building, plus flexible remote

description_html:
Commercial Account Executive (DACH/Nordics/CEE)

Location: London, UK

About AppViewX:

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform, which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.

Values

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together. 

  • We Do What We Say: We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity. 
  • We Are Trusted Experts: We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need. 
  • We Raise the Bar: We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results. 
  • We Win Together: We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates. 

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX. 

Role Overview

The Commercial Sales Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth, identifying new market opportunities, and managing the entire sales cycle for our products/services across designated territories. This role requires a highly motivated, results-orientated professional with a deep understanding of international business and complex commercial negotiations. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who can operate independently in diverse, fast-paced international markets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Business Development

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve and exceed sales targets and expand the company's customer base.
  • Identify and qualify new commercial opportunities through market research, networking, and cold outreach in various international markets.
  • Manage the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, presentation, proposal generation, negotiation, and contract closure with customers, distributors, and partners.
  • Focus on generating significant pipeline and growth. 

Market and Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients.
  • Gather market intelligence on industry trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes to inform product development and sales strategy.
  • Represent the company at industry events and conferences.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to localize sales materials and campaigns.

Sales Operations and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales forecasts and activity reports using the company's CRM system.
  • Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews to senior management, outlining regional performance, challenges, and future strategy.
  • Ensure compliance with all international trade regulations and company policies.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of progressive commercial sales experience
  • Demonstrated ability to close complex, high-value commercial deals in a diverse geographical territory.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in German and English.
  • Willingness to travel internationally frequently (up to 50% of the time).

Preferred

  • Experience with a global distribution network or channel partner model.
  • Proven track record of managing and expanding sales into new, emerging markets.

Travel Requirements

  • Travelling to customers, partners and events as and when required.
