title: Senior SAP Berater / Entwickler S/4HANA Transformation (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at promantis GmbH
description_html:
Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft der EnergiewirtschaftProfessionell. Progressiv. Proaktiv.

Die promantis GmbH steht seit 2008 für SAP- und IT-Beratung mit Leidenschaft, Kompetenz und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. Unsere Mission ist es, die digitale Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und weiterer Branchen mit verlässlicher Beratung, technischer Exzellenz und nachhaltigen Lösungen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden von der strategischen Ausrichtung über die technische Umsetzung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Go-live. Besonders im Umfeld von SAP Utilities und S/4HANA-Transformationen unterstützen wir führende Energieversorger bei einer der größten technologischen Veränderungen der Branche.

Und genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Aufgaben

S/4HANA-Transformationen sind weit mehr als Systemmigrationen. Sie verändern Prozesse, Datenmodelle und Arbeitsweisen nachhaltig.

Als Senior SAP BeraterIn / EntwicklerIn übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei unseren Transformationsprojekten und sorgst dafür, dass Daten, Prozesse und Systeme erfolgreich in die neue SAP-Welt überführt werden.

Dabei bringst Du Deine technische Expertise ebenso ein wie Deine Beratungsstärke und arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, Projektteams und Entscheidern zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du konzipierst und realisierst Datenmigrationslösungen für anspruchsvolle S/4HANA-Transformationsprojekte.
  • Du analysierst SAP- und Non-SAP-Quellsysteme und entwickelst passende Extraktions-, Mapping- und Transformationskonzepte.
  • Du entwickelst und optimierst Migrationsprogramme sowie Datenqualitäts- und Validierungstools.
  • Du unterstützt bei Data Cleansing, Datenharmonisierung und Qualitätssicherung.
  • Du automatisierst und optimierst Migrationsprozesse hinsichtlich Qualität, Stabilität und Performance.
  • Du führst Tests durch und begleitest fachliche sowie technische Go-lives.
  • Du berätst Fachbereiche, Key User und Data Owner bei fachlichen und technischen Fragestellungen.
  • Du gestaltest aktiv Transformationsprojekte im SAP Utilities Umfeld mit und bringst Deine Ideen ein.

Qualifikation

Fachlich

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in SAP S/4HANA-Transformations- oder Migrationsprojekten
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in ABAP und idealerweise ABAP Objects
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Datenmigration, Datenmodellierung und Datenqualitätssicherung
  • Erfahrung mit SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW oder vergleichbaren Migrationswerkzeugen
  • Kenntnisse in SAP Utilities bzw. SAP IS-U sind von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung in der Analyse komplexer System- und Prozesslandschaften

Persönlich

  • Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Lösungsorientierung und Qualitätsanspruch
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Kommunikationsstärke im Austausch mit Fachbereichen und IT
  • Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln

Benefits

Beratung ohne klassischen Beratungsdruck

  • Ca. 90 % Remote-Arbeit
  • Planbare Reisetätigkeit statt permanenter Kundeneinsätze
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Vertrauensarbeitszeit
  • Gehalt je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation (ca. 80.000–100.000€ p.a.).

Zukunftsthemen mit echtem Impact

  • S/4HANA-Transformationen bei führenden Energieversorgern
  • Digitalisierung energiewirtschaftlicher Kernprozesse
  • Moderne SAP-Technologien und innovative Projektlandschaften

Weiterbildung, die wirklich stattfindet

  • Individuelle Schulungen und Zertifizierungen
  • Raum für Forschungs- und Innovationsthemen
  • Wissenstransfer und fachlicher Austausch im Team

Kultur, die gelebt wird

  • Menschlichkeit, Vertrauen und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe
  • Mitgestaltung statt Vorgaben
  • Offene Feedback- und Lernkultur
  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält

Weitere Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Workation-Möglichkeiten
  • Hansefit
  • E-Bike-Leasing
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Zusatzkrankenversicherung
  • Transparente Karriere- und Gehaltsmodelle
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events

Dann lass uns miteinander sprechen.

Wir freuen uns auf Persönlichkeiten, die nicht nur Systeme transformieren möchten, sondern gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft gestalten wollen.

Bewirb Dich ganz unkompliziert mit Deinem CV bei uns.

Falls Du Fragen hast, kontaktiere mich gerne via XING, LinkedIn, klassisch per Mail oder Telefon +49 173 452 9770.

Noch mehr zu uns erfährst Du über unsere Karriereseite oder auf Kununu.

Vielen Dank für Deine Zeit und Dein Interesse.

title: Engineering Manager, Computing Platform
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Wolt - English
description_html:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to neighborhoods of the world. As part of that mission, we're building a unified platform designed to power DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and future growth. The primary computing platform is mainly a code execution framework that lets product teams compose business logic into graphs, while the team owns the platform, runtime, and operational experience.

We're now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our EU-based Computing Platform team. This is a team of 5 engineers working on a foundational, mission-critical platform that helps simplify backend development at scale by reducing operational overhead for product teams and making cross-team changes easier to build, test, and ship. In this role, you'll grow the team, shape the roadmap, and work closely with product and platform partners and your manager to make the Computing Platform more reliable, performant, and easier to adopt across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.

What you'll be doing

This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of platform strategy, people leadership, and execution. You'll lead a team building core capabilities that help engineers ship business logic without owning the burden of running services themselves. Success in this role means growing a strong team, driving clear priorities, and delivering platform improvements that make the Computing Platform easier for developers, and safer, faster and more reliable to use at massive scale.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, creating clarity, strong execution habits, and a healthy engineering culture.
  • Own the team's roadmap and delivery across core Computing Platform areas such as performance, scaling and resource management, I/O optimization, integrations, developer experience, and observability.
  • Partner closely with adjacent platform teams and product domains onboarding to Pedregal, turning their needs into platform capabilities and smoother adoption paths.
  • Guide architectural and technical decisions for the Computing Platform runtime and developer-facing APIs, balancing reliability, simplicity, and long-term extensibility.
  • Raise the bar on operational excellence by improving reliability, debuggability, and support for teams running production workloads on the Computing Platform.
  • Help shape the next phase of the Computing Platform as a foundational platform for Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash through hiring, prioritization, cross-team alignment, and org leadership.

Our humble expectations

  • At least 3+ years of solid experience as an engineering manager, including directly leading and growing a team of engineers in a fast-paced environment.
  • At least 5+ years of strong background in backend, infrastructure, product or platform engineering, and good technical judgment when working with distributed systems, runtime platforms, or developer-facing infrastructure.
  • You know how to turn an ambitious platform vision into clear priorities, pragmatic execution plans, and reliable delivery.
  • You're comfortable working across team boundaries and partnering with engineering, product, and platform stakeholders to drive alignment and adoption.
  • You care deeply about people leadership and know how to coach engineers, create clarity, and build a healthy, high-performing team culture.
  • You hold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and operational excellence, and can help teams navigate production challenges with calm and structure. 

What we offer

This is an opportunity to lead a foundational platform team working on one of the most important backend building blocks. The Computing Platform is designed to simplify how engineers build and operate business logic at scale, and the work of this team has the potential to influence developer productivity, system reliability, and platform adoption across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.

You'll get to work on meaningful engineering leadership challenges with broad scope: growing a strong team, shaping technical direction, and helping define how mission-critical compute platform evolves as more domains onboard. If you're excited by high-leverage platform work, complex distributed systems problems, and the chance to have impact far beyond a single product surface, this is a rare role to step into.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

Sie suchen eine positive berufliche Veränderung? Sie möchten den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere gehen und streben möglicherweise sogar eine Partnerschaft in einer zukunftsorientierten Kanzlei an? Sie möchten endlich wieder in einem positiven Arbeitsumfeld arbeiten, in dem Sie finanziell und persönlich wertgeschätzt werden? Sie suchen nach Tätigkeiten, die Sie auch wirklich weiterbringen?

Sofern Sie sich in mindestens einem der genannten Punkte wiederfinden, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden. Wir haben die attraktivsten Arbeitgeber der Steuerberatungsbranche in unserem Netzwerk und bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Grenzenlose Entwicklungschancen mit Partnermöglichkeiten, vielschichtige Tätigkeitsbereiche, Gehälter wie in der Industrie und vieles mehr – melden Sie sich bei uns und wir unterstützen Sie auf Ihrem weiteren Karriereweg!

Derzeit suchen wir nach einem Steuerberater (m/w/d) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Mittelstetten

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Wir bringen zusammen, was zusammengehört. Dabei spielt das passende Tätigkeitsprofil natürlich eine entscheidende Rolle. Bei unserer Partnerkanzlei können Sie sich Ihren Aufgabenbereich auf Basis Ihrer persönlichen Stärken und Schwächen selbst zusammenstellen.

  • Erstellung und Review von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von Steuererklärungen für Personen- und Kapitalgesellschaften
  • Steuerliche Sonderberatungsprojekte auf Basis individueller QualifikationenB. in den Bereichen der Erbschaftsteuer oder des Umwandlungssteuerrechts
  • Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Teamleitung und Personalverantwortung (optional)
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die Ihnen Freude bringen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Führungsverständnis und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gegenüber Mitarbeitern (optional)
  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Sie haben genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen Sie nicht wirklich profitieren? Dann sollten Sie einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung von 90.000 € bis 130.000 € / Jahr, auf Wunsch auch Partnerperspektive
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf Home-Office
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen wie z.B. Fachberater Qualifikationen
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient Ihren Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an Sie, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. lhre Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Sie führen keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses merken, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor Ihrem Bewerbungsgespräch all Ihre mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen Ihre Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens.
  • 100% Anonymität – solange Sie uns nicht das „Go“ geben und einem Kennenlernen mit Ihrem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmen, erfährt niemand von Ihrem Namen oder Ihren bisherigen Arbeitgebern – Ihre Ihnen wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären.
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.).
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für Sie.

description_html:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE
  • Au sein de la Direction de la Communication, vous intégrerez le pôle Communication Interne & Éditorial de Veepee. Vous serez plus particulièrement chargé(e) de contribuer à la valorisation des initiatives liées aux collaborateurs, qu’il s’agisse d’informations clés RH, de programmes internes, d’actions de développement, ou encore de projets transverses portant sur l’engagement, la culture d’entreprise et la RSE.
    •  
  • Accompagné(e) d’une cheffe de projet, vous prendrez en autonomie un périmètre de communications internes à forte dimension “collaborateurs”, en lien avec différents interlocuteurs métiers (dont les équipes RH), tout en participant à la mise en place d’événements et d’actions internes.
    •  
  • Votre rôle mêlera coordination, production éditoriale, création visuelle et gestion opérationnelle de projets

    • 🎯 MISSIONS
  • 1. Gestion d’un périmètre de communication interne orienté “initiatives collaborateurs”
  • Structurer et accompagner les besoins de communication sur les sujets liés à la vie interne : programmes, informations clés, actualités, dispositifs collaborateurs…
  • Collecter et formaliser les briefs auprès des équipes concernées (People, développement interne, learning, engagement…).
  • Rédiger et diffuser les contenus sur les canaux internes :e-mails, posts Slack, articles intranet, communications visuelles de messages pédagogiques ou informatifs diffusés sur les écrans dynamiques.
  • Assurer la cohérence éditoriale et proposer des formats adaptés selon les audiences.
    •  
  • 2. Coordination & gestion de projets transverses (RSE, engagement, culture d’entreprise)
  • Participer à la conception et à l’animation d’actions internes : moments forts RSE, Marronnier RH, campagnes de sensibilisation, initiatives d’engagement, projets menés avec le Fonds Veepee.
  • Gérer les aspects opérationnels de communication : planning, coordination des parties prenantes, suivi logistique et diffusion.
    •  
  • 3. Création de contenus & design
  • Concevoir des supports visuels variés : infographies, visuels pour écrans, bannières, mini-guides, éléments pour l’intranet…
  • Décliner des messages en formats visuels adaptés, principalement via Canva.
  • Veiller à la cohérence graphique avec l’identité visuelle de Veepee.

    • 👉 MUST HAVE SKILLS
  • Étudiant(e) en Bac+4/5 en communication / RH, école de commerce  ou formation équivalente.
  • Intérêt marqué pour la communication interne, la vie d’entreprise et les projets à impact collaborateurs (développement RH, engagement, inclusion, culture…).
  • Excellente plume et capacité à vulgariser des sujets variés.
  • Très bonne maîtrise de Canva, et/ou d’outils de PAO.
  • Organisation, rigueur, sens des priorités et autonomie.
  • Aisance relationnelle : coordination, prise de briefs, interactions régulières avec divers métiers.
  • Créatif(ve), curieux(se), force de proposition et à l’aise avec les outils digitaux.
  • Anglais courant indispensable.

    • ✅ BENEFITS
  • 👉Bureau flexible avec au minimum 3 jours sur place et jusqu'à 2 jours à domicile
  • 👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne
  • 👉Comité d’entreprise CE et ses nombreux avantages
  • 👉Accès à une restauration d'entreprise et cantine connecté
  • 👉Accès à la Salle de sport
  • 👉Congés selon la durée du contrat

    • ⚙️RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  • 1️⃣ Entretien téléphonique RH (30 mins)
  • 2️⃣ Entretien visio avec le manager (1h)
  • Cas pratique éventuel
    • The Veepee Group processes your data collected as part of the management of your recruitment in order to manage your application file for the position for which you have applied. To find out more about our personal data protection policy, we invite you to consult it on our career site.

title: HR Data Analyst - CDI (F/H/X)

description_html:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.
 

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Rattaché(e) à la Directrice Compensation & Benefits Groupe au sein de la Direction des Ressources Humaines, vos missions principales seront de :

🎯 MISSIONS

  • Élaborer la production de rapports légaux tels que Bilan social, supports de NAO, rapport d’égalité H/F et index égalité H/F, rapport RSE, BDES, etc. 

  • Préparer, en lien avec la Direction des Relations Sociales, diverses présentations à l’attention des représentants du personnel ;

  • Produire et  suivre les différents rapports et KPIs appuyant directement la stratégie RH, tels que les rapports effectifs mensuels, l’analyse du turnover, de l’absentéisme, etc. Il sera de votre responsabilité de donner un sens aux données ;

  • Elaborer et produire les enquêtes trimestrielles et annuelles (ACEMO, ECMOSS, PIPA, BMO) ;

  • Gérer  la cohérence des données RH du Système d’Information Monde (WORKDAY).

  • Assurer la transition vers des solutions intégrants l’IA pour produire ces data

  • Être force de proposition pour le développement de nouveaux indicateurs et la production de nouveaux formats de reporting.

 

Vous participerez, en relation avec l’Équipe SIRH, à l’amélioration continue des processus d’intégration et de contrôle de l’information.

👉 PRÉ REQUIS

  • De formation supérieure, Ecole RH / Finance, de Commerce ou équivalent,

  • Vous avez au moins 2 ans d’expérience en reporting RH ou contrôle de gestion social.

  • Vous êtes capable de prendre du recul, d’analyser et de synthétiser un flux important de données. 

  • Vous avez une vraie sensibilité pour les problématiques RH et le sens de la confidentialité. 

  • Curieux(se), motivé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous avez le sens des priorités, vous êtes force de proposition et orienté(e) solutions. 

  • Vous avez envie d’évoluer dans un environnement complexe et exigeant, rempli de défis et d’opportunités à saisir.

  • Vous maîtrisez très bien Excel (fonctions avancées, TCD, graphiques)

  • Vous avez un appétence affirmée pour l’IA et avez l’envie de vous perfectionner

  • La maîtrise opérationnelle de la langue anglaise est indispensable.

✅ AVANTAGES

  • 👉 Prime variable 
  • 👉 Participation aux bénéfices et plan d'intéressement 
  • 👉 Bureau flexible avec au minimum 2 jours sur place et jusqu'à 3 jours à domicile
  • 👉 Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne
  • 👉 Comité d’entreprise CE
  • 👉 Mutuelle

⚙️PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

  • ▶️ Premier entretien téléphonique avec un recruteur pour échanger sur votre compréhension du poste, votre expérience, vos motivations personnelles et professionnelles ainsi que vos valeurs. 
  • ▶️ Echange en visioconférence avec votre futur manager pour approfondir les échanges sur vos connaissances et motivations.
 
Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes reconnues en situation de handicap.
 
Nous sommes convaincus que c'est à vous de définir votre façon de travailler, de vous développer et de progresser. Chez Veepee, nous vous garantissons que vous pouvez tout simplement être vous-même ! Au service de la diversité et de l'inclusion, Veepee s'engage à examiner toutes les candidatures reçues sur une base égalitaire.

description_html:
About the team

At Equativ, we're on a mission to develop advertising technologies that empower our customers to reach their digital business goals. The impact of Generative AI on the industry is projected to be major, and Equativ has been undergoing a significant transformation to embed this technology at the core of our value proposition.

The GenAI team is a new, strategic unit (6–8 people) responsible for the design, development, and deployment of Equativ's entire GenAI stack. You will be joining a team of 3 developers and 2 product managers. It is split into two complementary pillars:

  • Core Platform — designing and building a reusable, industrialized Agentic Platform (MaaS, AaaS, Model/Agent as a Service) to accelerate agent development across the company.

  • Business Feature — the team you will be joining. We develop and deploy mission-critical AI agents that automate workflows for non-technical internal teams (operations, ad quality, marketplace, finance support, etc.). Our backlog targets people who today rely on manual processes and ad-hoc tooling, your work will give them autonomous, measurable, production-grade AI assistants.

This team is part of the R&D department (200+ engineers across Paris, Nantes, Limoges, Krakow, Berlin and North America), all working in an Agile environment.


What you will do

  • Create reusable components and libraries (Python + n8n) for the Business Feature Team, leveraging existing workflows and agents to accelerate future development.

  • Perform maintenance (TMA) on existing workflows and agents, focusing on resolving issues and improving performance.

  • Partner directly with non-technical stakeholders, sit with operations teams, understand their pain points, translate workflows into agentic solutions, and explain your design choices.

  • Collaborate with the team on Python development, contributing to the production codebase by applying software engineering principles (unit tests, CI/CD, Git, code review) and helping implement AIOps/AgentOps best practices.


About you

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or similar technical fields.

  • Experience with Python, and using Git for collaboration. You are comfortable working in group projects and collaborating within a team, with a strong desire to learn AIOps/MLOps best practices in a professional environment.

  • Proven experience building production-ready agent workflows with Google ADK (strongly preferred), Langchain, or LangGraph.

  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (Vertex AI, Kubernetes or equivalents) for deploying scalable GenAI services.

  • You can sit down with a non-technical stakeholder, draw out their workflow, and come back with a working agent.

  • Versatile, autonomous, and proactive, you love taking initiatives and driving your projects, with a strong desire to grow while being mentored by our solid team of developers and product managers.

  • Fluent technical English (written and verbal) mandatory.


Practical

  • Status: Internship

  • Location: Paris

  • Working language: English

Equativ, a leading independent ad platform, brings scale and simplicity to digital advertising.
 
Following its recent merger with Sharethrough and the acquisition of Kamino Retail, advertisers, media owners, and technology partners rely on Equativ’s advanced SSP, curation, and retail media services and technology to achieve maximum business outcomes.
 
With a focus on privacy-first programmatic video, CTV, and data-driven solutions, Equativ enables clients to activate across the digital ecosystem while protecting consumer privacy.
 
The company’s global expertise is also backed by a team of over 750 employees across 19 countries.
 
As a proud recipient of the HappyIndex@Work label, Equativ is committed to providing a dynamic, flexible workplace where employees thrive, grow, and excel in both their professional and personal lives.
Come and lead the charge with us in building a transparent ecosystem based on quality!

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Schiller International University
description_html:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility

title: Senior Creative Strategist (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at WeCreate Germany
description_html:
They do 08/15. We create 9:16

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. Du führst Creative Reviews, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und gibst Kund:innen sowie internen Teams Orientierung, wenn strategische, kreative oder operative Fragen zusammenkommen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der integrierten Arbeit mit dem Team: Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat arbeitest du im WeCreate-Office in Hamburg. Zusätzlich bringst du die notwendige Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate mit auch dann, wenn diese außerhalb deines üblichen Arbeitsortes stattfinden.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du gibst Marken und Teams Richtung. Du sorgst dafür, dass strategische Klarheit nicht in Präsentationen endet, sondern in kreativen Systemen, relevanten Inhalten und konsistenter Markenwirkung sichtbar wird.

Du verbindest die Perspektiven von Kund:innen, Creative Studio, Beratung, Produktion und Plattformen. Dabei bist du mehr als Ideengeber:in. Du entwickelst die Logik hinter der Arbeit, führst durch komplexe Entscheidungen und stellst sicher, dass Qualität über alle Projektphasen hinweg erkennbar bleibt.

Als Senior Creative Strategist stärkst du nicht nur einzelne Kundenprojekte, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Kompetenz von WeCreate als Organisation.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategische und kreative Gesamtverantwortung: Du führst komplexe Kunden-Mandate ganzheitlich von digitaler Markenpositionierung, Plattform- und Kanalstrategie bis zur kreativen Leitidee und belastbaren Umsetzungslogik.
  • Seniorige Kunden- und Teamführung: Du präsentierst Strategien und Kreativkonzepte überzeugend, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und führst interdisziplinäre Teams zu klaren, tragfähigen Entscheidungen.
  • Creative Strategy und Narrative Systems: Du entwickelst kulturell relevante Leitideen, Narrative und Content-Systeme, die über Plattformen, Formate und Touchpoints hinweg funktionieren.
  • Qualitäts- und Entscheidungsführung: Du sicherst die strategische und kreative Qualität von der Aufgabenstellung bis zum finalen Output, gibst präzises Feedback und erkennst früh, wenn Idee, Marke und Plattformlogik auseinanderlaufen.
  • Playbooks, Standards und fachliches Sparring: Du entwickelst verbindliche Leitplanken für das Creative Studio und bist ein:e erfahrene:r Sparringspartner:in für Kund:innen sowie Creative-, Strategy- und Beratungsteams.
  • Coaching und Wissensaufbau: Du teilst dein Wissen aktiv, coachst Kolleg:innen und stärkst nicht nur einzelne Arbeiten, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Arbeitsweise des Teams.
  • Systemische Zusammenarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit Social-, Creator-, Community-, Production- und Paid-Teams zusammen, begleitest relevante Produktionen und Offsites und entwickelst interne Prozesse sowie KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen weiter. Dafür bringst du Reise- und Terminflexibilität mit.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Herausforderungen in klare strategische Positionierungen, kreative Leitideen und umsetzbare Content-Systeme übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der strategischen und kreativen Gesamtverantwortung für anspruchsvolle Kunden-Mandate, Kampagnen oder Markenaufgaben.

  • Du kannst Plattform- und Kanalstrategien entwickeln und mit einer übergreifenden Content-Systematik verbinden.

  • Du präsentierst komplexe Strategien sicher vor Entscheider:innen und auf C-Level und kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu klaren Entscheidungen führen.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content, Plattformkultur und gesellschaftliche sowie kulturelle Signale.

  • Du kannst kreative Qualität über Konzept, Briefing, Produktion und finalen Output hinweg sichern und Feedback präzise, konstruktiv und verbindlich formulieren.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, Playbooks, Standards oder Leitplanken zu entwickeln und Wissen in Teams wirksam zu vermitteln.


So arbeitest du

  • Du denkst strategisch und kreativ zugleich und verlierst dabei weder die Marke noch die Plattform oder die Umsetzbarkeit aus dem Blick.

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und schaffst Orientierung, wenn Anforderungen komplex oder noch nicht vollständig geklärt sind.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest gerne integriert mit anderen Disziplinen und weißt, dass die beste Arbeit selten am eigenen Schreibtisch entsteht.

  • Du bist bereit, mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat im Hamburger Office zu arbeiten und für Produktionen, Workshops sowie Offsite-Formate flexibel vor Ort teilzunehmen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu coachen und strategische sowie kreative Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bekommst du bei uns:

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

  • Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt

  • Freie Wahl deiner Hardware


Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen

  • Gemeinsame Events und Workations, weil gute Zusammenarbeit nicht nur im Kalender entsteht

  • Wahlweise Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Probonio-Gutschein oder Urban Sports Club

  • Bagel-Frühstück im Office für einen gemeinsamen Start in den Tag


Und sonst?

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise

  • Eine steile Lernkurve – ohne Dauer-Überstunden als vermeintliches Karriereprogramm

  • Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Flache Hierarchien sowie ein respektvoller, offener Umgang miteinander


Hinweis zur Anstellung:

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet – mit Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis.


Klingt nach dir?

Dann bewirb dich über unser Karriereportal:

https://wecreate-germany-gmbh.jobs.personio.de/

WeCreate möchte einen inklusiven, diversen und authentischen Arbeitsplatz schaffen. Vielleicht bist genau du die Person, die diese Rolle weiterdenkt. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Account Director, Digital Natives - France
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at OpenAI
description_html:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

 

In this role, you'll:

  • Manage ~dozen key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan

  • Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to succesful deployment

  • Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

  • Own a consumption revenue target

  • Manage consumption revenue forecasts

  • Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies

  • Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates

  • Support the development of company culture

We're seeking someone with experience including:

  • 5-7+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service

  • Achieving revenue targets >$1M per year for more than 3 years

  • Designing and executing complex deal strategies

title: Director, GTM Partnerships, SME & growth
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Airwallex
description_html:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role...

As Partnerships Director, France & Spain, you will lead and develop a team of four partnership managers:

  • Two Accounting Partnerships Managers

  • One Venture Capital Partnerships Manager

  • One Travel & E-commerce Partnerships Manager

You will own the partnerships strategy and commercial performance across both markets, building a channel-led growth engine that generates qualified introductions, partner-sourced pipeline and net-new business for Airwallex.

This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role. You will set direction, develop the team and build the operating model, while personally sourcing, negotiating, activating and growing strategic partnerships.

The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. The broader scope includes Payments and Venture Capital and may evolve with business priorities.

The role is based in either France or Spain, with a minimum of three days per week in the relevant Airwallex office.

What you’ll do...

  • Own the France and Spain partnerships strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

  • Set partner ICPs, commercial priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations and operating standards across the team.

  • Lead, coach and develop the four partnership managers.

  • Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical.

  • Build repeatable referral, reseller, co-selling and partner-led outbound motions across Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce and VC.

  • Ensure signed partnerships become active commercial channels, not passive logos.

  • Work with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Track active partners, referrals, opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution.

  • Test partner segments and commercial motions; scale what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey.

What you’ll bring...

  • 8+ years in partnerships, channel sales, indirect sales, partner sales, strategic business development or a comparable commercial role.

  • A successful 0-to-1 partnership motion or vertical launch in Accounting or Travel & E-commerce, with measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue.

  • Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital.

  • A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers.

  • Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships.

  • Experience designing partner ICPs, activation motions, attribution and channel performance management.

  • Experience leading, coaching or developing partnership professionals is preferred. Formal people-management experience is valuable, but not the only indicator of leadership potential.

  • Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment.

  • Professional English plus native or bilingual French or Spanish. Native or bilingual proficiency in the other local language is a strong advantage, but not required.

  • Comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, partner economics and basic business cases.

Who you are...

  • Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details.

  • Channel-led: you care about net-new business and revenue, not only signed agreements or ecosystem visibility.

  • A builder: you create structure from zero, test quickly and learn without waiting for a perfect playbook.

  • Commercially accountable: you use data to decide where to invest, coach or stop.

  • A player-coach: you develop people while continuing to win strategic partnerships yourself.

What success looks like...

  • The four partnership managers have clear mandates, partner ICPs, account priorities and measurable pipeline objectives.

  • Accounting and Travel & E-commerce have prioritised partner strategies and active channel motions in France and Spain.

  • Partner cohorts are recruited, activated and connected to repeatable referral, reseller or co-selling motions.

  • You personally own strategic partnerships that contribute materially to Airwallex’s growth.

  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline is accurately tracked and converted with clear Sales ownership.

  • The team scales the highest-performing partner segments and quickly deprioritises inactive or low-potential relationships.

Why join Airwallex...

You will own a strategic growth engine across France and Spain and shape how Airwallex builds channel-led growth in the region.

  • Director-level ownership across two European markets

  • Strategic and hands-on player-coach role

  • Direct ownership of partner-sourced growth and strategic partnerships

  • Opportunity to build scalable channels across Accounting, Travel, E-commerce, Payments and VC

  • Hybrid role in France or Spain: minimum three days per week in the relevant office

  • Competitive salary, commission and equity

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: DPO & Compliance Officer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Filigran
description_html:
🌀 The Company

Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture.

Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a DPO & Compliance Officer to design and implement Filigran’s practical, scalable compliance program.

You will be Filigran’s formal Data Protection Officer, ensuring strong privacy governance across our products, operations and international footprint. You will also lead the day-to-day design and delivery of broader compliance workstreams, including AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls and sanctions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CEO, CISO, People, Product, Engineering and Sales teams, helping Filigran meet regulatory expectations in a business-minded attitude.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Act as Filigran’s Data Protection Officer and primary point of contact for supervisory authorities, including the CNIL, and for data subjects.

  • Design and operate Filigran’s privacy program, including ROPAs, DPIAs, privacy by design, retention, data-subject rights, breach assessment and international data transfers.

  • Lead the design and operational implementation of compliance controls across AI governance, NIS2, operational resilience, export controls and economic sanctions, under the General Counsel’s leadership.

  • Maintain a proportionate compliance framework, including policies, risk mapping, monitoring plans, internal controls and clear reporting.

  • Partner with Security to translate regulatory requirements into practical, business-enabling policies and controls that work for a fast-growing cybersecurity company.

  • Partner with Security, Product and Engineering to embed privacy, AI and regulatory requirements into product development, vendor management and customer assurance.

  • Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, UK, US and other relevant markets, and provide clear recommendations to the General Counsel and executive team.

  • Support enterprise sales and procurement by responding to privacy, AI governance and compliance requirements.

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

You will have a split reporting line:

  • For your statutory DPO responsibilities, you will report directly to the CEO. You will have the independence and access to senior management required to carry out those responsibilities.

  • For all other compliance responsibilities, you will report to the General Counsel, who retains ultimate accountability for Filigran’s wider compliance programme and material compliance decisions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CISO, Security, Product, Engineering, Sales, People and Finance teams. You will lead delivery across the programme while knowing when to escalate decisions and draw on internal or external specialists.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 7 to 10 years’ experience as a DPO, data privacy lead or compliance officer, ideally in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company.

  • Demonstrable expert knowledge of data protection law and practice. A recognized DPO certification or IAPP qualification, such as CIPP/E, is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with a company-wide implementation of the EU AI Act.

  • Deep, hands-on command of GDPR and UK GDPR, including ROPAs, DPIAs, breach management, data-subject rights and international transfers.

  • Demonstrable ownership of at least two adjacent regulatory programmes, such as AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls or economic sanctions.

  • Able to lead unfamiliar workstreams with sound judgement and appropriate specialist internal or external support.

  • Comfortable translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into proportionate controls that work operationally.

  • Able to build strong relationships and credibility with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment.

  • Autonomy, ownership and team spirit.

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in the privacy & compliance function

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or a technical B2B SaaS environment; fluency in English and French.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We’re a fast-growing, global, and fully remote company building open-source cybersecurity solutions, increasingly powered by AI, to help defense teams anticipate threats and act faster.

⭐ What we believe

We believe we do work that matters, uniting defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient & collaborative.

💻 How we work

We do work that matters by combining strong engineering standards with emerging technologies, including AI, to move faster and smarter.

🧭 What guides us

We make our work matter by building a culture grounded in our CORE values of Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility, and Equity. The principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people, and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive pay + equity - everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first, flexible, and balanced - work that fits your life

  • Your setup, your choice - pick the gear that works for you

  • Twice-a-year gatherings - we meet in person for regional and global offsites to connect, collaborate, and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion - from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of our people make our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity, and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from, or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

title: Workplace Experience Manager

description_html:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

As our Workplace Experience Manager in Paris, you will be the heartbeat of our office, transforming ordinary workdays into vibrant, hospitality-driven experiences. You’ll take full ownership of building a thriving local community, executing memorable events, and ensuring our facilities run like a well-oiled machine. By adapting global initiatives to fit our unique Parisian flair, you’ll directly shape our culture and create an energizing environment where top talent loves to gather, collaborate, and thrive.

🛠️ The Day-to-Day

  • Lead the Experience: Elevate daily office operations and spearhead a warm, polished, hospitality-driven environment for all employees, visitors, candidates, and customers.

  • Curate the Culture: Own the local engagement calendar from concept to execution, crafting memorable themed events, social activities, cultural celebrations, and wellness initiatives.

  • Master the Operations: Manage facilities, vendor relationships, repairs, supplies, cleaning, food and beverage, security, access, and floor plan management seamlessly.

  • Build Strong Alliances: Cultivate meaningful relationships with local employees, leadership, landlords, building management, and cross-functional global partners.

  • Drive Strategic Growth: Oversee the workplace budget, purchase orders, and spending forecasting while supporting office projects, space planning, tech rollouts, and branding installations.

  • Listen and Evolve: Gather employee feedback continuously to identify high-impact opportunities and adapt global workplace programs to reflect the true spirit of Paris.

⚡ Your Superpowers

  • Proven Track Record: Brings 5+ years of experience successfully managing workplace operations, facilities, hospitality, or employee experience independently.

  • Event Mastery: Possesses hands-on expertise in conceptualizing, budgeting, and hosting high-quality, creative, and engaging community events.

  • Operational Excellence: Demonstrates strong skills in vendor management, budget forecasting, space planning, and facilities logistics.

  • Bilingual Communication: Speaks and writes with professional fluency in both French and English to effortlessly bridge global and local teams.

  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Takes complete ownership with energy, adaptability, excellent organization, and a true passion for bringing people together.

🎯 Bonus Points

  • Fast-Paced Savvy: Prior experience working within a global tech or fast-moving organization.

  • Design & Space Vision: An eye for office branding, space layout optimization, and workplace aesthetics.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

  • Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.

As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Any individuals requiring a reasonable accommodation or would like to voluntarily disclose a disability or protected veteran status to assist with their employment application should send an e-mail to ----- The email should also include the position you’re interested in.

title: Global VP, Talent Acquisition

description_html:
About Sidetrade:

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

Today, we're looking for our Global VP of Talent Acquisition to build and lead our Ai-native shift and create the dream team for our next stage of growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership challenge for designing a scalable, data-driven talent acquisition function across all regions in the world (North America, Europe, and APAC), all functions and levels -from AI expert to GTM and from Mid-level to Executives. You'll partner directly with the executive team and hiring managers to ensure we attract, hire, and onboard the talent needed to hit our growth targets, while building a TA function that's efficient, candidate-centric, and built for scale.

Because it’s instrumental to the strategy, this role will report directly to the CEO.

What you would do:

title: Game Designer (Gameplay Modes) - Paper.io 2
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Voodoo
description_html:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Paper.io 2, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io2.

Role

Paper Party is the multiplayer mode of Paper.io 2. We are looking for a dedicated Game Designer to improve the modes we already have and create new ones from scratch.

All modes will keep the Paper universe, camera and controls. Beyond that, there is a lot of creative freedom. You will explore new rules, objectives, win conditions, pacing and team setups to create a broad range of fun and replayable multiplayer experiences.

You will:

  • Design and prototype new gameplay modes

  • Improve existing Paper Party modes

  • Define simple, readable rules for one-finger controls

  • Iterate quickly through testing, feedback and playtests

  • Balance accessibility, competition, pacing and replayability

  • Identify weak ideas early and confidently cut or reshape them

  • Work closely with the Paper.io 2 team to turn concepts into playable experiences

  • Document your designs clearly

  • Fine-tune modes directly in Unity whenever possible

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving quickly from an idea to a playable prototype, testing it and improving it.

Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile F2P games, designing new games, gameplay modes or prototypes from scratch

  • Experience shipping player-facing content, ideally in mobile games

  • A strong understanding of multiplayer and competitive gameplay

  • A good sense of pacing, clarity and player motivation

  • A pragmatic and iterative approach: prototype, test, cut and retry

  • The ability to work independently and take full ownership

  • Strong English communication and collaboration skills

Nice to have

  • Strong Unity experience

  • Ability to prototype directly in the engine

  • Experience with mobile controls, multiplayer or party games

  • Experience working on live games or live content

title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic

description_html:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
